title: Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

OpenGov is seeking a Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering to lead our enterprise systems engineering function in Pune - a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of complex integrations with people leadership. You'll remain deeply technical, designing and owning integrations across our enterprise application stack (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce via API) alongside your team, while managing, coaching, and growing the systems engineers who build them. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in shaping technology decisions.

Based in Pune, working closely with US and India-based teams across time zones.

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Remain hands-on in the design, build, and ownership of complex integrations across enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and Salesforce using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of enterprise systems engineers, owning performance management, career growth, and hiring
* Lead project planning and execution across enterprise systems integration initiatives, ensuring on-time delivery and clear stakeholder communication
* Partner with stakeholders across R&D, GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to prioritize the roadmap and align it to business needs
* Serve as a key voice - alongside Enterprise technology leadership - in shaping technology decisions, integration patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Establish and improve team processes, documentation standards, and operational rigor to support long-term platform stability
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues
* Facilitate agile ceremonies for the team, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to keep delivery predictable and visible

**Position Qualifications**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 8+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience
* Experience managing or leading technical teams, including performance management and career development
* Demonstrated experience building integrations using REST, GraphQL, and/or SOAP APIs across different systems, with strong understanding or functional knowledge of scripting languages such as Python
* Hands-on experience with one or more of: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce
* Strong project management skills, with experience planning and delivering cross-functional technical initiatives
* Strong understanding of IAM concepts and access governance across SaaS platforms
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* BA/BS in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred:**

* Experience with iPaaS/automation platforms (Workato or similar)
* Experience managing a distributed team across US and India time zones
* Experience facilitating Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
* Working understanding of serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda or equivalent

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

To be successful you should have experience with:

Some other highly valued skills may include:

title: Team Lead - Software Technology
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. You will guide architecture and engineering practices, mentor software engineers, and drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, including agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work on a hybrid schedule in Pune/Noida, India.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and support.

* Lead architectural and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable enterprise software solutions.

* Drive practical adoption of AI-assisted software engineering, including Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI solutions, to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.

* Identify, prototype, and scale AI use cases using Python, APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous or multi-agent workflow patterns while applying appropriate security, privacy, human oversight, and responsible AI controls.

* Guide Agile execution through PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, effort estimation, risk identification, and delivery commitments.

* Review requirements, technical designs, code, test cases, and user documentation to ensure adherence to engineering standards and quality practices.

* Mentor engineers on modern software practices and effective, responsible use of AI coding assistants and automation tools.

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineering Managers, QA, UX, DevOps, data, AI, and global development teams to achieve product and program objectives.

* Lead troubleshooting, debugging, integration, and resolution of complex technical issues across systems and subsystems.

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

* 10+ years of experience in software development, software design, and enterprise application development.

* 3+ years of experience in a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or comparable technical leadership role.

* 5+ years of experience conducting design reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.

* Mandatory hands-on Python experience for automation, data processing, API integration, prototyping, or AI-enabled application development.

* Mandatory practical experience using enterprise generative AI and coding-assistant tools such as Microsoft Copilot or GitHub Copilot in software engineering workflows.

* Demonstrated understanding of agentic AI concepts, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, and safe deployment of AI agents.

* Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings or vector search, and integration of AI services through APIs.

* Ability to apply responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, intellectual-property, and model-risk controls when using AI-generated code or AI-enabled solutions.

* Strong experience in software architecture, object-oriented design, system integration, debugging, and enterprise application development.

* Experience leading Agile software development teams and participating in SAFe or a similar scaled Agile framework.

* The ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Experience designing or implementing agentic or multi-agent solutions using frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain, or AutoGen.

* Experience building AI-enabled applications on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, or related data and AI services.

* Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, guardrails, observability, cost controls, and adoption metrics for enterprise use cases.

* Strong expertise in Java, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and enterprise application design patterns.

* Experience with modern UI/UX technologies and enterprise user interface development.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, containerization, virtualization, and modern software delivery approaches.

* Knowledge of test automation strategies and development practices such as TDD and BDD.

* Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, MES, or consumer products industries.

* Demonstrated success influencing technical direction, driving engineering excellence, and developing high-performing engineering teams.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes ...

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.

* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

* Company volunteer and donation matching program.

* Employee Assistance Program.

* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program.

* On-demand digital course library for professional development.

... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right person for this or another role.*

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy expects employees to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation outside the office.

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

**Polyglot Full Stack Developer (Lead) Experience**

***Pune, India (GCC) — on-site / hybrid as applicable***

*8–10 years Team Leadership*

*Must have led a team of 5–6 developers Employment Type*

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, versatile Full Stack Developer to lead a small engineering team and drive delivery across multiple technology stacks. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing production code, architecting systems, and mentoring a team — and who thrives on picking up new tools and technologies as project needs evolve, rather than sticking to a single fixed stack.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications spanning backend services, frontend interfaces, and data layers.

* Lead and mentor a team of 5–6 developers — assigning work, conducting code reviews, unblocking issues, and owning delivery quality and timelines.

* Own system design and architecture decisions for new features and services, balancing scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.

* Build and maintain backend services in Java and Python, and frontend applications using React JS.

* Apply AI/ML concepts and tools where relevant to enhance product features or internal tooling.

* Containerize applications with Docker and support deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP).

* Design efficient, well-structured SQL schemas and queries; optimize database performance.

* Drive engineering best practices: Git workflows, code review standards, CI/CD, testing, and documentation.

* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.

* Evaluate and rapidly adopt new tools, frameworks, or languages as project requirements demand.

* Participate in technical planning, estimation, and risk identification for projects across the portfolio.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall software development experience, with demonstrated full stack delivery.

* Proven experience leading a team of 5–6 developers, including mentoring, code review, and delivery ownership.

* Strong hands-on expertise in Java for backend development.

* Strong hands-on expertise in React JS for frontend development.

* Working proficiency in Python.

* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, tools, or frameworks (e.g., applied ML, LLM integration, or data science fundamentals).

* Practical experience with Docker for containerization.

* Solid working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

* Strong SQL skills — schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.

* Demonstrated ability to design scalable, maintainable systems (system design fundamentals: caching, load balancing, microservices, API design, etc.).

* Proficiency with Git and standard branching/collaboration workflows.

* Expert, daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review.

* A polyglot mindset — genuine willingness and ability to pick up new technologies, languages, or frameworks as project requirements dictate.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

* Experience working in a distributed or GCC (Global Capability Center) setup supporting multiple business units or product lines.

* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices.

* Prior experience modernizing or rebuilding legacy platforms.

**What We're Looking For**

Beyond the technical checklist, we want someone who is curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating across ambiguity — a developer-leader who can go deep on any layer of the stack, guide a small team effectively, and is energized rather than daunted by switching technologies when a project calls for it.

*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.*

### **Why Join Us?**

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

* **Health and Wellness:**
  + Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
* **Retirement Savings:**
  + 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.

* **Paid Time Off:**
  + Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
* **Parental Leave:**
  + 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
* **Remote Work Support:**
  + Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
* **Holidays:**
  + Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

The MetLife EMEA Technology organization is evolving to enable MetLife’s New Frontier strategy. * Support customer training, operational readiness, and knowledge transfer activities where required.

* Support deployment, commissioning, and validation of Unbox Robotics solutions.

* Ownership and accountability

You’ll help keep it running.

Deliver process engineering duties in the Production and Support Systems Squad, within the Production Management Unit (PMU). Collaborating with the PMU Process Engineering Team Lead.

  

The PMU uses innovative digital and data science technologies to perform Monitoring & Surveillance, model-based optimization, and capacity assessments. Focused across 4 chokes (Reservoir – Wells – Plant – Export) and 4 product streams (Oil – Gas – Water – Carbon).

  

The Production and Support Systems Squad is a multi-discipline squad of petroleum, process, instrument and control, electrical, and rotating equipment engineers that delivers monitoring & surveillance, model-based optimization, and capacity assessments to the Production Delivery Units (PDUs). The P&SS squad works in partnership with the PDU production management squad to deliver against the production management workflows and realize increased production or production protection opportunities.

  

The Process Engineer within the P&SS Squad leads the tools deployed for system monitoring and surveillance in Palantir Foundry and PI AF systems, and for topsides optimization using Hysys through the Vertex Foundry interface. Additionally, the process engineer will support definition and deployment of new solutions for M&S and optimization.

  

The PMU is global unit developed during Reinvent with a phenomenal opportunity to build new capability that delivers significant value to the existing hydrocarbon businesses in production but also transferable skills and capabilities for other areas. title: Staff Quantum Computing Engineer
description:
Pune, Maharashtra, India

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19531 **Date posted** 11/09/2026

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years at the edge of what computing can do, and you know that quantum is not magic, it is math, physics, and a lot of careful engineering to figure out where it actually helps. You think in algorithms and implementations, not hype cycles. You have built things in Qiskit or PennyLane or Cirq, run experiments on real quantum hardware or simulators, and debugged why a circuit that worked in theory fell apart in practice.

You are comfortable moving between theory and code. You can read a paper on variational quantum eigensolvers, implement it in Python, and then sit with an EDA engineer to figure out if it could ever scale to a real workflow. You do not need a perfect roadmap to start exploring. You ask the right questions, build the proof-of-concept, and know when to pivot.

Research excites you, but so does impact. You want your work to eventually matter beyond a publication. At Synopsys, you will help evaluate whether quantum computing can create real differentiation in CAE and EDA, and you will build the prototypes that prove it out.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms for CAE and EDA applications, focusing on optimization, simulation, and computational problems relevant to Synopsys workflows
* Research emerging quantum technologies and assess their applicability to real product use cases, separating signal from noise in a rapidly evolving field
* Build software prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and tech demos using quantum frameworks like Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, or QuTip, and validate them against classical HPC baselines
* Collaborate with internal engineering teams, academic researchers, and industry partners to explore quantum approaches and translate research into practical engineering insights
* Contribute to patents and publications in top quantum computing conferences and journals
* Integrate quantum workflows with HPC and classical computing environments to build hybrid solutions that scale
* Ramp up on Synopsys EDA and simulation technologies to understand where quantum methods could create meaningful advantage

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Help Synopsys evaluate and adopt next-generation quantum computing technologies that could differentiate future CAE and EDA products
* Turn quantum research into practical engineering capabilities by building prototypes that validate real-world applicability
* Identify quantum algorithms and approaches that can improve computational workflows in silicon design, simulation, and analysis
* Build the technical foundation for quantum integration as hardware matures and becomes commercially viable
* Contribute to Synopsys intellectual property portfolio and thought leadership in quantum computing for EDA
* Bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and product engineering, ensuring quantum exploration stays grounded in business value
* Strengthen Synopsys partnerships with academic institutions and quantum hardware providers through collaborative research and proof-of-concepts

### **What You'll Need**

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with focus on quantum computing, quantum information, or computational science
* Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++ for building algorithms, simulations, and scalable software
* Hands-on experience with quantum computing frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, QuTip, or similar platforms
* Solid understanding of quantum algorithms including VQE, QAOA, QFT, quantum optimization techniques, or quantum simulation methods
* Experience with HPC, CUDA, MPI, or scientific computing environments is a strong plus
* Track record of research contributions through publications, patents, or open-source quantum software projects is valuable

### **Who You Are**

* You can explain a complex quantum algorithm to a classical HPC engineer in two sentences without losing the technical nuance or overselling the capability
* Self-driven and comfortable working in ambiguity, you do not wait for a perfect problem statement to start exploring solutions
* You have a learning mindset and stay current with quantum computing research, but you also know how to focus on what matters for industry-scale problems
* Strong collaborator who can work across disciplines, from physicists to software engineers to product managers, and find common ground quickly
* You think critically about where quantum actually helps and where it does not, and you are not afraid to say when a classical approach is still the right answer
* Organized enough to manage research exploration, prototype development, and stakeholder communication without losing momentum

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Office of Innovation, a team focused on bringing research and advanced computing technologies to Synopsys. The mission is to drive near-term and long-term innovation by exploring quantum computing, AI and foundation models, and HPC acceleration. Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

**Why join Coupa?**

* **Pioneering Technology:** At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
* **Collaborative Culture:** We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
* **Global Impact:** Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

**The Impact of an AI Engineer at Coupa:**

We are seeking a hands-on Agentic AI Developer / AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy generative AI solutions leveraging Google Cloud's AI ecosystem. This role is a core part of our AI Delivery "Build" team, responsible for translating business challenges into production-ready AI agents and solutions using Google ADK (Agent Developer Kit), Vertex AI, and related Google Cloud services that create measurable business value.

This position combines deep technical expertise with practical execution on Google's AI platform, ensuring that our agentic AI solutions are well-designed, robustly built, and successfully deployed. The Agentic AI Developer will partner closely with business stakeholders, QA Specialists, and Cloud Engineers to build, test, and scale responsible AI solutions from concept to production within the Google Cloud environment.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Design & Build with Google ADK:** Design, develop, test, and deploy autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents using Google ADK, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and agentic patterns to address key business challenges.

* **Vertex AI Implementation:** Leverage Vertex AI capabilities including model training, fine-tuning, vector search, and orchestration to build production-grade AI solutions that integrate seamlessly with enterprise systems.

* **End-to-End Development:** Own the end-to-end technical lifecycle of AI projects on Google Cloud Platform, from initial proof-of-concept and prototyping through to production deployment using Vertex AI Pipelines, monitoring with Vertex AI Model Monitoring, and continuous iteration.

* **Google Cloud Integration:** Build integrations between AI agents and Google Cloud services including BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and enterprise data sources to enable intelligent automation across the organization.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and collaborate closely with QA Specialists and Cloud Engineers to ensure solutions are reliable, scalable, and seamlessly integrated within GCP infrastructure.

* **Responsible AI Implementation:** Implement, test, and monitor safeguards for AI agents using Vertex AI's responsible AI tools to mitigate risks, including bias detection, model explanability, compliance monitoring, and operational limits. Ensure solutions are fair, explainable, and robust.

* **Agentic Architecture with ADK:** Contribute to the architecture and selection of frameworks, tools, and orchestration logic using Google ADK and Vertex AI to build, manage, and scale multi-agent systems effectively.

* **Iterate & Improve:** Monitor agent performance in production using Vertex AI monitoring tools, gather feedback, and iteratively improve models, prompts, grounding strategies, and agent logic to drive successful adoption and business impact.

### **What You Will Bring to Coupa:**

* Proven experience (3-5+ years) in software engineering, data science, or AI/ML solution delivery with demonstrated Google Cloud Platform expertise.

* Hands-on experience with Google Vertex AI, including model deployment, endpoint management, and AI agent development.

* Strong knowledge of AI/ML fundamentals, agentic AI patterns (e.g., ReAct, planning, tool use, function calling), and experience with Google ADK or Vertex AI Agent Builder.

* Proficiency in Python and Google Cloud AI/ML libraries including Google ADK, Vertex AI SDK, and common data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/JAX).

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub) and MLOps principles including Vertex AI Pipelines and CI/CD.

* Demonstrated success in building and deploying AI/ML models and solutions into production on cloud platforms.

* Demonstrated experience in a forward deployed role where you owned the business outcome, not just the ticket.

* Comfort operating in ambiguity. You can walk into an undefined business problem, scope it with the people who own it, and ship something useful within weeks.

* Experience integrating AI or automation into enterprise SaaS platforms (ERP, CRM, HRIS, procurement, ITSM) through REST APIs, webhooks, event streams, or middleware.

* Strong written communication. You can explain a cost and accuracy tradeoff to a CFO and a stack trace to an engineer on the same afternoon.

* Working knowledge of at least one non-Google model provider and its tooling (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI), including function calling and tool use across providers.

* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred:

* Experience with Vertex AI features including vector search (Matching Engine), model monitoring, custom training, and model tuning.

* Hands-on experience with Gemini API, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns on Google Cloud.

* Experience with containerization (Cloud Run, GKE) and serverless architectures for scaling AI applications.

* Familiarity with Google Cloud security best practices, IAM, and data governance frameworks.

* Hands-on experience with responsible AI practices using Vertex AI Explainable AI, Model Monitoring, and bias detection tools.

* Experience with LLM frameworks (ie Crew, ADK, LangChain, LangGraph) integrated with Google Cloud services.

* Hands-on experience with Anthropic Claude and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building custom MCP servers, connectors, and agent skills.

description:
**IT Solutions Lead**

**Location: Pune (Maharashtra)**

**Life Unlimited.** At Smith+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living as an accomplished Low-Code / No-Code Tech Lead to own the technical direction, delivery excellence and team leadership of our enterprise low-code portfolio built on Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) and Mendix.

  

**What will you be doing?**
---------------------------

As a hands-on technical leader, you will set architecture standards, lead and mentor a team of developers, govern the platform at scale and partner with business and IT leadership to turn strategic priorities into secure, compliant and scalable digital solutions. You will also shape how AI-assisted development and automation are adopted across the organization.

* (35%) Lead, mentor and grow a team of low-code engineers and citizen developers; set technical direction, coding standards and review practices
* Own technical delivery across multiple concurrent programs, including estimation, sprint planning, risk management and release readiness
* Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues and make pragmatic build-vs-buy and platform-selection decisions
* Conduct design and code reviews to ensure quality, performance and maintainability
* Define and evolve low-code reference architectures, patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Provide platform-selection guidance: Power Apps for simple and productivity use cases, Mendix for complex, enterprise-grade applications
* Ensure scalability, resilience, performance and cost-efficiency across environments and tenants
* Contribute to the low-code platform roadmap, licensing strategy and capacity planning
* (35%) Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps (Canvas & Model-driven), Power Automate and Mendix Studio Pro
* Deliver end-to-end solutions covering UI/UX, data models, business logic, workflows and microflows
* Remain hands-on for critical components, proofs of concept and technical spikes
* (20%) Architect integrations with enterprise systems (SAP, ServiceNow, Azure services and other APIs) using connectors, REST APIs and middleware
* Design secure, performant data models and data flows across Dataverse and Mendix domain models
* Embed data governance, privacy, security and compliance within applications
* Establish and enforce platform governance: environment strategy, ALM, DLP policies, naming conventions and app lifecycle management
* Implement audit trails, role-based access and data controls; support SOX and other compliance-driven workflows
* Collaborate with security, risk and audit teams on platform controls and remediation
* Define and operate CI/CD pipelines, version control, automated testing and release management for low-code platforms
* Drive monitoring, support models, SLAs and continuous performance optimization
* Champion Agile / Scrum delivery and engineering best practices
* (10%) Partner with business stakeholders, architects, product owners and delivery teams to translate requirements into solutions
* Build and run a Center of Excellence (CoE) and citizen developer enablement program, including training and guardrails
* Communicate technical strategy, progress and risks clearly to senior leadership
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted (vibe coding) development, Copilot capabilities, automation and accelerators to improve productivity
* Evaluate emerging platform features and recommend adoption with clear business value
Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation  

**What will you need to be successful?**

* Education: Bachelor´s degree in Computer Science or related subject preferred.

* Licenses/ Certifications: Relevant entry- or mid-level security certifications are advantageous but not required. Job-specific training will be provided.

* At least 10+ years of experience in a MS Power Platform and Mendix

* Experience working hands-on development for atleast 4-5 yrs in MS Power Platform, Mendix and other Lowcode Nocode Platforms.

**Competences:**

* 10–12 years of experience in application development, including at least 4–5 years in a technical lead or team lead role with a strong low-code focus
* Deep hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse
* Deep hands-on expertise in Mendix (Studio Pro, Microflows, Domain Models, Integrations)
* Hands-on experience with AI-driven vibe coding development techniques
* Strong experience with REST APIs, integrations and middleware platforms
* Good understanding of Azure services (preferred)
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale low-code solutions
* Strong knowledge of application architecture, security, performance and governance
* Familiarity with SOX / compliance-driven workflows (preferred)
* Strong understanding of Agile / Scrum delivery models
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, version control and environment management
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and inspire technical teams
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including with senior leadership
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and to balance speed, quality and risk
Strong ownership, decision-making and problem-solving mindset  

**Nice to Have**

* Certifications in Power Platform (e.g., PL-600 Solution Architect) and/or Mendix (Advanced / Expert Developer)
* Experience with Appian / ServiceNow workflows
* Experience establishing a low-code Center of Excellence
Experience working with global, distributed teams

We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.

* **Your Future:** Major medical coverage + policy exclusions and insurance non-medical limit. Educational Assistance.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title- Public Websites Requirements Engineer, AVP**

**Location- Pune, India**

**Corporate Title:** **Assistant Vice President**

**Role Description**

* We are seeking an experienced **Requirements Engineer** with at least 12 years of experience in the Banking and Financial Services industry to elicit, define, and document system requirements that support our digital content strategy for public websites built on Adobe Experience Manager.
This is an engineering role and any prior experience in analysis, coding, systems design and delivery will only become an advantage to excel in the role.  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

We are looking for someone who is a team player and who has the following responsibilities:

* Requirements elicitation:
  + Independently conduct interviews, workshops, and surveys
  + Align requirements with stakeholders
  + Facilitate and guide cross-functional requirements sessions with other Requirements Engineers
* Requirements analysis
  + Analyse and decompose large-scale business requirements into implementable functional and non-functional solution requirements
  + Assess the complexity and dependencies of the identified requirements
  + Enhance and structure requirements by involving technical stakeholders and Solution/Enterprise Architects
  + Identify and resolve conflicts, ambiguities, and inconsistencies
* Requirements documentation
  + Create and maintain structured documentation in accordance with common TDI PB standards
  + Familiarity with industry standards for documentation and commonly used modeling languages
* Requirements management
  + Use suitable tools and frameworks to ensure traceability and version control.
  + Capture and update requirements
  + Perform impact analyses
Guide teams comprising multiple Requirements Engineers or working on cross-application initiatives  

**Your skills and experience**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and good to have experience in the German language.

* Technical background or a strong technical understanding of IT systems, interfaces, and architecture

* Extensive experience with modeling techniques using UML, SysML, BPMN and Diagramatic representations of solutions.

* Familiarity with Documentation as Code and usage of Jira / Jama as a requirements repository tool.

* Extensive experience with IDEs and CI/CD toolchains

* Understanding of common IT architecture, principles, design patterns, and non-functional requirements (NFRs)

* **AI experience:** Working knowledge in MS Copilot, Claude CoWork to help with documentation and project status reporting / planning if required.

* **Adobe Services Knowledge** : Familiarity with Adobe Managed Services or Adobe Cloud Services would be an added advantage to excel in the role.

* **Agile Methodology** : Strong understanding and promotion of Agile values familiar with tools such as JIRA and Confluence.

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**About Nexus**
---------------

You don't have an AI story if you don't have your data story. That's where NexusOne comes in.

We're the converged data platform for the AI era — composable by design, built on an open-source foundation, and AI-native from the ground up. One identity, one governance envelope, one operational layer across every mainframe, data lake, warehouse, and streaming system in the business. For the first time, enterprises can bring their existing stack along instead of rebuilding it — and still give AI agents full context across the estate.

What we stand for is simple: sovereign data, interoperable systems, decoupled intelligence — delivered the way modern software should be. No rip-and-replace. No multi-year transformation. Our CEO Anu Jain puts it well: we turn the "ball of yarn" of data integrations into a unified engine — less like assembling car parts, more like buying the car ready to drive. 85+ open-source tools pre-integrated. AI-native automations that deploy and self-heal the stack without human toil. Forward-deployed engineers who build shoulder-to-shoulder with customer teams — hands on keyboards, not just on decks.

It's working, and fast. We're tripling revenue year over year, backed by Insight Partners, and running in production in environments most vendors won't touch. Our platform processes credit risk data for 90%+ of US small businesses — 40M+ — every month. Intent signals for 300M+ subscribers monthly for Africa's largest telco. The data and AI layer for a Top 3 US bank.

We're 100+ people across the US and India, headquartered in Atlanta. We think big, move fast, and don't mistake activity for progress. We hire people who'd rather ship the rocket than brief someone on it.

Check out this podcast of Anu talking about our solution here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g8g50sv5GhQ

We are currently searching for a 100% Hands-on Data Platform Engineer to join our high-performing product team in Pune. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with expertise in Kubernetes platform/strong python/terraform Automation skills and meticulous attention to detail. This person will be intellectually curious with a relentless desire to learn the latest modern data architecture platforms and patterns.

**What You are and will work on:**

* Install, configure, and support NX1 product clusters in cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises environments, ensuring seamless integration and functionality using Kubernetes, Spark, NiFI, Kafka, Airflow, Trino, Hive, Iceberg, Jupyter, yarn, Impala, Ranger and Hbase ensuring robust data protection and compliance.
* Maintain, patch, and upgrade existing NX1 product setups in a 24 x 7 environments, ensuring minimal downtime and adherence to best practices.
* Configure Datadog/Grafana agents and develop dashboards to monitor and alert operations teams
* Manage daily operations with oncall rotations of Nexusone products and cloud-based technologies using open-source Linux-based data technologies.
* Evaluate and optimize complex distributed production deployments, identify bottlenecks, and recommend performance enhancements.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including administration of runbooks and knowledge base articles, to support operational excellence and knowledge sharing.
* Work in an agile team and Participate in an on-call rotation, providing expert-level support and troubleshooting for critical issues.
* Lead and mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, solution architects, and DevOps, to design and implement scalable data solutions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying this knowledge to improve the CDP environment and drive innovation.

**General expectation:**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in installing and administering Data Platform (Cloudera, Databricks, snowflake) or using open-source tools, with a proven track record of managing large-scale deployments.
* Hands-on experience with python/terraform automation skills for open-source Linux-based data technologies.
* Proven ability to build and support solutions across major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), leveraging cloud-native tools and open source for optimal performance.
* Experience integrating Azure Active Directory with FreeIPA and other directory services such as LDAP, enhancing security and user management.
* Up-to-date knowledge of the Hadoop Big Data ecosystem, staying current with the latest technologies and best practices.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills, with a thorough understanding of capacity planning, identifying bottlenecks, and optimizing memory utilization, CPU usage, OS performance, storage, and network configurations.
* In-depth understanding of both on-premise and cloud network architectures, ensuring seamless integration and efficient data flow.

**Nice to have:** Cloudera/Databricks/Snowflake Administrator certification is a plus.  
  
Prior experience as a support or development engineer with a focus on Data, Analytics, and AI.

**Why You’ll Love Working at Nexus**
------------------------------------

At Nexus, we value people who want to grow — and support each other while doing so.

You can expect:

* A collaborative team culture built on curiosity and respect
* Challenging work where your contributions clearly matter
* A leadership team that invests in learning and development

If this role sounds like a great fit — or even *close* to one — we’d love to hear from you. We know that no candidate checks every single box, and we’re excited to meet people who bring curiosity, talent, and a desire to build meaningful work together.

title: Embedded Development Engineer
description:
At Emerson, we help the world run safer and smarter. As a global leader in automation, our Analytical Instruments organization develops advanced technologies and solutions that safeguard industries and keep critical systems running.

Join our Liquid Analysis team in Pune, India, as a Embedded Software Engineer II — where you'll work on both new product development and sustaining engineering for process analytical equipment that protects water quality, supports life sciences, strengthens industrial safety, and serves industries worldwide.

If solving complex engineering problems with software excites you, this is an opportunity to build real embedded products, work closely with software, hardware, systems, and test engineers, and see your work come together in the complete product - become part of a team that’s growing, learning, and focused on delivering results!

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Design and develop embedded software features and components for new products, product enhancements, and sustaining engineering.
* Develop and maintain software requirements, detailed designs, interfaces, tests, and traceability for owned features; participate actively in technical and peer reviews.
* Work on assigned, develop estimates, and maintain accurate work status in Azure DevOps.
* Solve embedded software problems through hands-on development, debugging, testing, and root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with technical and feature leads and global, cross-functional teams across software, test, systems, hardware, project management, and product management.
* Follow engineering practices aligned with our SDLA and IEC 62443-4-1, including requirements, design, cybersecurity, implementation, testing, reviews, documentation, traceability, and release.
* Maintain and improve existing products while contributing ideas, tools, and approaches that improve product quality and engineering effectiveness.

**Who You Are:**

You take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks.

You deal constructively with problems that do not have clear solutions or outcomes.

You grow from hardships and negative experiences

You partner with others to get work done.

You admit mistakes and gain insight from experiences.

Korn Ferry Competencies: Nimble Learning, Manages Ambiguity, Being Resilient, Collaborates, Demonstrates Self-awareness

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science from an engineering school required.
* Minimum of three (3) years of applicable experience

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
* Experience developing and delivering embedded software features for real-time, multi-threaded systems and microcontroller-based products
* Demonstrated ability to solve embedded software and hardware/software integration problems through debugging, testing, and root-cause analysis
* Proficiency in C/C++, with practical experience in modular embedded software design, object-oriented design, design patterns, and UML
* Experience estimating effort and managing individual work in Azure DevOps or a similar tool

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to industrial Ethernet protocols and stacks such as EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, or PROFINET is a plus
* Working knowledge of embedded communication interfaces and industrial protocols such as CAN, SPI, UART/SCI, I²C, HART, Modbus, or PROFIBUS
* Experience with requirements-based development, technical and peer reviews, configuration management, traceability, and secure software development practices; familiarity with IEC 62443-4-1 is preferred

**Why Join Our Team?**

We're building the next generation of Liquid Analysis products around a highly visible program with significant market potential. It's real embedded engineering across software, electronics, sensors, communications, automation, cybersecurity, and test. We're also growing the software team around it, so people joining now can influence not only the products, but architecture, automation, engineering practices, AI, and how the team works.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**

**Clarity Quality Speed.** We want curious people who jump in, learn fast, communicate openly, ask questions, challenge constructively, work through disagreements, and then align and move. Development and test are partners, and quality belongs to the whole engineering team.

At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers. This philosophy is fundamental to living our company’s values and our responsibility to leave the world in a better place. Learn more about our Culture & Values and about Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Emerson. **The Opportunity**
-------------------

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

**Why join Coupa?**

* **Pioneering Technology:** At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
* **Collaborative Culture:** We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
* **Global Impact:** Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

**The Impact of a AI Engineer at Coupa:**

We are seeking a hands-on Agentic AI Developer / AI Engineer to design, build, test and deploy agentic AI solutions leveraging Google Cloud's AI ecosystem. This role is a core part of our AI Delivery "Build" team, responsible for translating business challenges into production-ready AI agents and solutions using Google ADK (Agent Developer Kit), Vertex AI, and related Google Cloud services that create measurable business value.

This position combines deep technical expertise with practical execution on Google's AI platform, ensuring that our agentic AI solutions are well-designed, robustly built, and successfully deployed. The Agentic AI Developer will partner closely with business stakeholders, QA Specialists, and Cloud Engineers to build, test, and scale responsible AI solutions from concept to production within the Google Cloud environment.

In a forward deployed role, You will embed directly with the portfolio teams whose problems you are solving, work in their tools and their meetings, and deliver agentic and automation solutions in the flow of work: inside the systems people already use every day, not as one more application they have to learn.

### **What You’ll Do**

* **Design & Build with Google ADK:** Design, develop, test, and deploy autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents using Google ADK, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and agentic patterns to address key business challenges.

* **Vertex AI Implementation:** Leverage Vertex AI capabilities including model training, fine-tuning, vector search, and orchestration to build production-grade AI solutions that integrate seamlessly with enterprise systems.

* **End-to-End Development:** Own the end-to-end technical lifecycle of AI projects on Google Cloud Platform, from initial proof-of-concept and prototyping through to production deployment using Vertex AI Pipelines, monitoring with Vertex AI Model Monitoring, and continuous iteration.

* **Google Cloud Integration:** Build integrations between AI agents and Google Cloud services including Gemini Enterprise, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and enterprise data sources to enable intelligent automation across the organization.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and collaborate closely with QA Specialists and Cloud Engineers to ensure solutions are reliable, scalable, and seamlessly integrated within GCP infrastructure.

* **Responsible AI Implementation:** Implement, test, and monitor safeguards for AI agents using Vertex AI's responsible AI tools to mitigate risks, including bias detection, model explainability, compliance monitoring, and operational limits. Ensure solutions are fair, explainable, and robust.

* **Agentic Architecture with ADK:** Contribute to the architecture and selection of frameworks, tools, and orchestration logic using Google ADK and Vertex AI to build, manage, and scale multi-agent systems effectively.

* **Prototype Fast, in the Open:** Ship a working prototype in days, not quarters. Put it in a real user’s hands early, watch them use it, and iterate on what you observe instead of what was requested.

* **Build MCP Servers and Tool Integrations:** Design, build, and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, connectors, and tool layers that give Claude, Gemini, and other models safe, governed, audited access to Coupa business systems and data.

* **Stay Multi-Model and Pragmatic:** Choose the right model, framework, and pattern for each job across Claude, Gemini, and open models. Make cost, latency, and accuracy tradeoffs deliberately instead of defaulting to one vendor.

* **Know When It Isn’t an Agent:** Recognize when workflow automation, a scheduled job, a cleaner integration, or simply deleting a step is the faster, cheaper, more durable fix. Reach for the smallest tool that solves the problem.

* **Instrument and Prove Impact:** Measure every deployment. Track usage, cycle-time reduction, hours returned, and error and escalation rates, then report results to stakeholders and leadership in business terms, not model metrics.

* **Carry Trust and Governance into the Field:** Apply security, privacy, data-handling, and responsible AI guardrails at the point of deployment. Engage Security, Legal, and Data Governance early so solutions clear review the first time.

* **Enable, Document, and Hand Off:** Leave behind runbooks, monitoring, and trained business owners so what you build survives without you. Convert one-off wins into reusable patterns, templates, and internal skills the whole AI Delivery team can redeploy.

* **Iterate & Improve:** Monitor agent performance in production using Vertex AI monitoring tools, gather feedback, and iteratively improve models, prompts, grounding strategies, and agent logic to drive successful adoption and business impact.

### **What You Will Bring to Coupa**

* Proven experience (3-5+ years) in software engineering, data science, or AI/ML solution delivery with demonstrated Google Cloud Platform expertise.

* Hands-on experience with Google Vertex AI, including model deployment, endpoint management, and AI agent development.

* Strong knowledge of AI/ML fundamentals, agentic AI patterns (e.g., ReAct, planning, tool use, function calling), and experience with Google ADK or Vertex AI Agent Builder.

* Proficiency in Python and Google Cloud AI/ML libraries including Google ADK, Vertex AI SDK, and common data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/JAX).

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub) and MLOps principles including Vertex AI Pipelines and CI/CD.

* Demonstrated success in building and deploying AI/ML models and solutions into production on cloud platforms.

* Demonstrated experience in a forward deployed role where you owned the business outcome, not just the ticket.

* Comfort operating in ambiguity. You can walk into an undefined business problem, scope it with the people who own it, and ship something useful within weeks.

* Experience integrating AI or automation into enterprise SaaS platforms (ERP, CRM, HRIS, procurement, ITSM) through REST APIs, webhooks, event streams, or middleware.

* Strong written communication. You can explain a cost and accuracy tradeoff to a CFO and a stack trace to an engineer on the same afternoon.

* Working knowledge of at least one non-Google model provider and its tooling (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI), including function calling and tool use across providers.

* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Lead Implementation Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Lead Implementation Engineer is a technical delivery person who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life across the most complex and highest-stakes deployments. This role owns the end-to-end technical strategy for large, multi-module implementations, from solution architecture and data migration design through configuration, testing, and go-live, and sets the technical quality bar for the entire Implementation Engineering organization.  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to senior government leaders, the Implementation Engineer IV combines deep product expertise with advanced data architecture, database, and automation skills. The role translates complex customer goals, legacy system constraints, and cross-departmental workflows into scalable, governed, and maintainable solutions. Beyond hands-on delivery, the Implementation Engineer IV shapes how the organization works: defining standards and reusable frameworks, coaching senior and mid-level engineers, resolving escalated technical risk, and driving the process and product improvements that make implementations faster, more consistent, and more repeatable for every customer.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the technical strategy and solution architecture for the most complex, multi-module government implementations across the United States, including large-scale data migrations, multi-system integrations, and multi-department rollouts
* Set the standard for configuration and data reviews across the implementation organization, approving final designs for high-risk deployments and ensuring alignment with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability
* Lead data architecture for customer migrations, defining source-to-target mapping strategies, ETL frameworks, reconciliation controls, and validation approaches that produce audit-ready data at scale
* Resolve critical technical blockers escalated from active implementations, performing root-cause analysis on data integrity, performance, and configuration issues and driving corrective action with Product and Engineering
* Lead requirements discovery with executive and technical stakeholders, pressure-testing assumptions, resolving conflicting departmental needs, and advising customers on design trade-offs with clear business impact
* Define comprehensive test strategies and quality gates for complex deployments, and ensure test scenarios validate that configuration, integrations, and migrated data produce accurate outcomes before go-live
* Serve as the senior technical advisor to government executives, Budget Directors, CIOs, and IT leadership, building long-term trust and guiding them through deployment, integration, and adoption strategy
* Mentor and develop Implementation Engineers across all levels, providing technical leadership, reviewing complex configuration and data work, and building the skills and career paths of the broader engineering team
* Establish and continuously improve implementation standards, playbooks, reusable tooling, and automation frameworks that raise delivery quality, consistency, and speed across the organization
* Identify systemic patterns in customer pain points and lead cross-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Data/Integration, Project Management, and Customer Success to simplify and automate workflows at scale
* Represent the voice of the customer in product and roadmap discussions, translating field insights into prioritized, well-scoped recommendations that shape the future of the platform
* Evaluate and champion emerging technologies, including AI-driven automation, to accelerate migration, validation, and implementation workflows while maintaining rigorous data governance and security standards

**Requirements and Preferred Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* 9 to 12 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, with a proven record of leading complex enterprise or SaaS deployments
* 7+ years of hands-on SQL experience, including advanced query design, performance tuning, data transformation, and reconciliation across large datasets
* 5+ years of Python or similar scripting experience for automation, data processing, and building reusable delivery tooling
* Deep expertise in database architecture and ETL and data-migration methodologies, including schema design, indexing and performance optimization, and governance of data quality at scale
* Demonstrated experience designing and leading AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, using modern frameworks and AI models
* Proven track record of owning multiple concurrent complex implementations end to end and of raising the technical capability of other engineers through mentorship, reviews, and formal knowledge sharing
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior government stakeholders, align cross-functional teams, and present technical strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous approach to validation, reconciliation, and sign-off, with a demonstrated ability to establish quality standards that others adopt
* Comfort operating with ambiguity in a rapidly changing product environment, making sound decisions under pressure, and adapting strategy as customer needs evolve
* Experience working with or within government, public sector, or regulated environments is strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: AVP - Microsoft Copilot and Agentic AI Engineer - IT Infrastructure
description:
Microsoft Copilot and Agentic AI Engineer

*Jefferies | Information Technology — Workplace AI | Pune, India | Full-Time | Individual Contributor*

Role Overview

Microsoft Copilot and Agentic AI Engineer — a mid-level individual contributor role in Pune, India, within the Workplace AI function in Information Technology. This role supports the firm's Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI productivity, automation and enterprise AI initiatives, working with a global team and overlapping US Eastern hours for coordination, vendor calls and change windows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will design, implement, administer and optimize Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, agentic AI solutions, Azure AI services, Claude Cowork and Claude Code, taking capabilities from proof of concept through to a governed production service. Every capability must respect the controls a regulated financial institution is held to, from Information Barriers and Purview data loss prevention to records management and least-privilege identity. We are looking for an engineer with consulting instincts who owns problems end to end and communicates precisely with business, Compliance and Legal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Copilot platform engineering and administration

* Design, deploy, administer and optimize Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat across the tenant, including licensing strategy, enablement waves, feature rollout, pilot cohorts and configuration baselines.
* Own the operational health of the Copilot estate: service health monitoring, message center and roadmap assessment, capacity and consumption tracking, and impact analysis for announced Microsoft changes.
* Troubleshoot complex platform, grounding and integration issues across Copilot, Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams, distinguishing client-side behavior from tenant configuration and genuine product limitations.
* Manage escalations with Microsoft engineering and support to closure and feed recurring product gaps back into the firm's roadmap discussions.

Agentic AI, Copilot Studio and Azure AI

* Build, deploy, manage and support Copilot Studio agents, declarative and custom engine agents, and bespoke AI assistants serving specific business functions.
* Design and implement agentic AI solutions that transform business processes, including multi-step orchestration, tool and connector integration, grounding strategy and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Configure and support Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service and the wider Azure AI service portfolio, including model selection, deployment, prompt design, evaluation and retrieval-augmented generation patterns over enterprise content.
* Administer the Microsoft 365 agent estate (Agent 365) — registration, identity, entitlement, lifecycle and inventory — so that agents are managed with the same rigor as any other enterprise application.

Automation and integration

* Develop and maintain automation solutions using Power Platform, Power Automate and related Microsoft technologies, replacing manual and repetitive operational processes.
* Integrate enterprise applications and data sources through APIs, Microsoft Graph, custom connectors and automation frameworks, with appropriate authentication, error handling and monitoring.
* Build reporting and telemetry pipelines covering adoption, usage, consumption and platform health, and present the findings in a form business and technology leadership can act on.

Governance, security and compliance

* Establish and maintain enterprise AI governance: operational standards, security controls, approval workflows, acceptable-use guardrails and a compliance framework covering Copilot, agents and agentic AI solutions.
* Design, administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Information Barriers to support regulatory, compliance and ethical wall requirements, and validate that Copilot and agent behavior honors those boundaries in practice.
* Ensure AI capabilities operate within Microsoft Purview controls — data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, information protection, records management, retention and audit — and evidence that compliance to reviewers.
* Design and maintain identity and access patterns in Microsoft Entra ID, including application registrations, API permissions and admin consent, certificate-based authentication, service principals and least-privilege role assignment.

Adoption, stakeholder engagement and continuous improvement

* Partner with business stakeholders across the firm to identify, qualify, priorities and deliver AI-enabled use cases, and to retire those that do not deliver measurable value.
* Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Information Security, Risk, Infrastructure and Data teams to secure approvals and to design controls into solutions from the outset rather than retrofitting them.
* Support enterprise AI adoption through training, user enablement, office hours, documentation, runbooks and structured change management.
* Drive continuous improvement and innovation across the AI and automation platforms, evaluating new Microsoft capabilities and recommending where the firm should adopt, pilot or wait.

Required Areas of Expertise Copilot, agents and agentic AI

* Microsoft 365 Copilot administration and engineering; Copilot Chat; Copilot agents; Copilot Studio; Microsoft 365 Agents and Agent 365 administration.
* Agentic AI architecture and implementation, including orchestration patterns, tool use, evaluation and safe failure behavior.
* Prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation concepts applied to enterprise content and structured data.
* Microsoft 365 platform administration across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams, and an understanding of how each grounds Copilot.

Claude Cowork, Claude Code and multi-vendor AI tooling

* Claude Cowork administration and engineering: workspace and user enablement, entitlement and licensing, connector and data-source configuration, skills and agent management, and day-to-day operational support.
* Claude Code administration in a controlled enterprise setting: rollout to developer environments, authentication and access control, repository and permission scoping, tool and command restrictions, and usage monitoring.
* Governance of Claude Cowork and Claude Code: acceptable-use policy, data handling and retention, audit logging and interaction reporting, model and feature approval, and evidencing compliance to Legal, Compliance and Information Security.
* Ability to operate a multi-vendor AI estate, applying consistent security and compliance controls across Microsoft and Anthropic tooling and advising the business on which platform suits a given use case.

Azure AI, automation and integration

* Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Services.
* Power Platform and Power Automate; process automation and workflow orchestration at enterprise scale.
* API integrations and automation frameworks, including Microsoft Graph and custom connector development.
* Enterprise platform monitoring, operational support and incident management.

Governance, compliance and identity

* Microsoft Information Barriers: deployment, administration, governance, troubleshooting and compliance validation.
* Microsoft Purview, data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, information protection and records management.
* Enterprise AI governance, AI security, risk management and regulatory compliance.
* Microsoft Entra ID and enterprise identity and access management.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology or a related discipline.
* Six to seven years of relevant experience across Microsoft technologies and enterprise platforms.
* Demonstrated experience with Microsoft 365 administration and engineering in a large, complex tenant.
* Hands-on experience implementing Microsoft Copilot and AI-powered productivity solutions in production, not solely in a lab or pilot setting.
* Practical experience with Copilot Studio, Azure AI services and the Power Platform.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, governance, compliance and risk management, and the judgement to apply it to novel AI scenarios.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications and services through APIs and automation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience administering and governing Claude Cowork and Claude Code in an enterprise environment, including enablement, access control and usage oversight.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience within financial services, investment banking, capital markets, asset management or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience establishing or operating an enterprise AI governance program.
* Experience managing large-scale Microsoft 365 and Copilot deployments across multiple regions.
* Working knowledge of SEC, FINRA and MiFID obligations, information barriers, records management and electronic communications compliance requirements.
* Microsoft certifications in Azure AI, Microsoft 365, security and compliance, Copilot, Power Platform or related technologies — for example AI-102, MS-102, SC-300, SC-401, PL-200 or PL-400.

Soft Skills
