* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capability across business and technology functions.
* Ability to pitch an explanation correctly for the audience, whether that is an engineer, a compliance officer or a business head.
* Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving, with a bias toward root cause over workaround.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently, carrying issues to closure without prompting.
* Collaborative mindset, with experience supporting globally distributed teams across time zones.

title: Associate Technical Support Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**So, what’s the role all about?**

NICE Public Safety provides a cloud based enterprise product used by public safety and justice agencies. Our customers depend on this product for time sensitive work, so the system has to be available at all times.

We are looking for an Associate Technical Support Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team in Pune. This is an early career role for someone with 1 to 3 years of experience who wants to build a strong foundation in cloud monitoring and production support. The main purpose of the role is to watch the health of our product hosted on Microsoft Azure, respond to alerts, carry out first level troubleshooting and escalate issues to senior engineers with clear and complete information.

The person will work under the guidance of senior Technical Support Engineers and is expected to learn quickly, follow established SOPs and gradually take on more ownership. We also expect them to be curious about AI tools such as Claude and Copilot and willing to use them in their daily work.

**How will you make an impact?**

* Monitor production systems on Azure using tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana and Kibana.
* Watch alert queues and dashboards, acknowledge alerts promptly and act on them as per the defined SOPs.
* Carry out first level troubleshooting by reviewing logs, metrics and recent changes, and document findings clearly.
* Raise and track incidents in the ticketing tool, escalate to senior engineers or Advanced Support on time and with complete information.
* Assist senior engineers during major incidents by gathering logs, running health checks and keeping notes.
* Help reduce false alarms by reporting noisy or misfiring alerts to the senior team.
* Use AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to help read logs, summaries incidents and draft updates.
* Write simple scripts to automate routine tasks such as reports and health checks, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Share clear and timely updates with internal stakeholders during incidents.
* Follow and help update SOPs, knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Meet the defined SLAs, KPIs and escalation processes.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in technical support, application support, NOC, production monitoring or cloud operations.
* Basic hands on exposure to Microsoft Azure and at least one monitoring or logging tool such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana or Kibana.
* Basic understanding of cloud concepts, web applications and how client server systems work.
* Working knowledge of Windows or Linux, including reading logs and checking services and processes.
* Basic scripting ability in PowerShell, Python or Shell, or a strong willingness to learn.
* Familiarity with a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow or Jira.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or ChatGPT for day to day technical work.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to explain a technical issue clearly to a senior engineer or a customer.
* Eager to learn, takes feedback well and follows processes carefully.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field (BE, BTech or BSc).
* Exposure to KQL queries in Log Analytics.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and how to test them.
* Awareness of Docker, Kubernetes or CI/CD pipelines.
* Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or ITIL Foundation certification.
* Interest in AI tools, prompt writing or building small automations.
* This role works in rotational shifts aligned to US time zones, including night shifts.
* The person will be part of a weekend on-call rotation shared across the team.
* The role is based in our Pune office and works with global teams.
* Work on a product that public safety and justice agencies rely on every day.
* Learn from experienced engineers and get hands on with the latest monitoring, automation and AI tools.
* Clear growth path to Technical Support Engineer and onward to Advanced Support, SRE, Cloud Operations or AI Operations.

title: Dental Annotator
description:
Dental Annotator

Company: scanO

Location: Baner, Pune

Work Mode: In-house | Full-time

Salary: ₹18,000 – ₹20,000 per month

Experience: 0–2 years | Freshers are welcome

Qualification: BDS

About scanO

scanO is an AI-powered oral health technology company focused on improving dental screening, patient education, and preventive care. We work at the intersection of dentistry and artificial intelligence to develop solutions that help dental professionals identify oral health concerns more efficiently and improve patient engagement.

Our team works with dental images, radiographs, and clinical data to build and improve AI-driven dental solutions for real-world clinical use.

About the Role

We are looking for a Dental Annotator to join our in-house team and contribute to the development of AI-based dental solutions.

The role involves reviewing and annotating dental radiographs and intraoral images using our annotation platform while following standardized dental annotation guidelines.

You will work closely with the clinical and AI teams to ensure that dental datasets are accurately labeled and consistently maintained for AI/ML model development.

Key Responsibilities

- Annotate dental radiographs, including OPG, IOPA, and Bitewing radiographs.

- Annotate intraoral dental images based on defined annotation guidelines.

- Identify and accurately label relevant dental findings and anatomical structures.

- Follow established annotation protocols and maintain consistency across datasets.

- Ensure high levels of accuracy and attention to detail while reviewing images.

- Meet assigned annotation quality and productivity targets.

- Participate in training, calibration, and quality-review sessions.

- Report unclear or difficult cases to the appropriate clinical team for review.

- Maintain confidentiality while handling clinical and image-related data.

- Contribute to the development and improvement of AI/ML datasets for dental applications.

Requirements

- BDS degree is mandatory.

- Freshers are welcome to apply.

- Good understanding of dental anatomy, clinical findings, and dental radiographs.

- Basic knowledge of interpreting OPG, IOPA, and Bitewing radiographs.

- Ability to understand and follow detailed annotation guidelines.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Good observation and analytical skills.

- Comfortable working with computers and digital platforms.

- Willingness to learn and adapt to new annotation tools and processes.

- Ability to work consistently on repetitive image-review tasks while maintaining accuracy.

- Willingness to work full-time from our Baner, Pune office.

What We Offer

- Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI and dentistry.

- Hands-on experience in dental AI dataset development.

- Training in dental radiograph and intraoral image annotation.

- Exposure to AI/ML applications in healthcare.

- Opportunity to work closely with dental professionals, AI engineers, and product teams.

- Practical experience in an emerging area of dental technology.

- Learning and growth opportunities within a fast-growing healthtech environment.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Education:

* Doctorate (Preferred)

* Exposure to non-functional testing strategies.

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. * Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
Pune, Maharashtra, India

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19532 **Date posted** 11/02/2026

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years building ML systems that work at scale, not just in notebooks but in production, where data pipelines break, training runs fail at hour 47, and someone has to own the fix. The difference between a model that ships and one that stays in research is usually the unglamorous work of versioning datasets, writing tests, and making sure the thing can actually be called from a product workflow. You are the engineer who closes that gap.

Scientific simulation data is different. Irregular 3D meshes, physics constraints that matter, and datasets where one bad simulation can poison a training run. You have worked with data like this before, or you are ready to learn why it matters. Either way, you know that the model is only as good as the data it was trained on, and you care about that upstream problem as much as the architecture.

Deployment is not someone else's job. You think about what happens after the checkpoint: how it gets packaged, how inference gets served, how a product engineer in a different timezone calls it without breaking their workflow. At Synopsys, you will build the infrastructure that makes Large Physics Foundation Models real for CFD, thermal, and electromagnetics products that customers actually ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and extend dataset factories that produce repeatable, versioned corpora across geometry, mesh, and solver setup using agentic orchestration, shared across CFD, Icepak (electronics cooling), and HFSS (high-frequency electromagnetics)
* Produce large, quality-gated datasets for training Large Physics Foundation Models, ensuring bad simulations are quarantined and data provenance is tracked end to end
* Take trained checkpoints through deployment: package models, stand up inference serving, and build integrations that product teams can call inside their workflows for initialization, prediction, or design-loop acceleration
* Partner with product teams to understand deployment constraints, test in real workflows, and support forward-deployed engineering when models go live
* Write production-grade Python with testing, versioning, CI, and operability for long-running jobs that span data generation, training, and serving
* Build data loaders and training pipelines for irregular 3D simulation data using PyTorch, handling distributed training, checkpointing, and physics-based evaluation metrics
* Own the ambiguous boundary between data engineering, model training, and product deployment, closing gaps instead of waiting for a perfect handoff

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable Synopsys simulation products to shift from "run a solver for every design" to "a model trained on high-fidelity data proposes a physically useful field in seconds," fundamentally changing how customers design cars, aircraft, chips, packages, and RF systems
* Build the data and deployment infrastructure that competitors cannot replicate from a research paper, giving Synopsys a durable advantage in physics-informed ML
* Accelerate design loops for customers by orders of magnitude, letting them explore more configurations, fail faster, and use expensive solvers only where fidelity still matters
* Create reusable dataset factories that scale across multiple physics domains, so campaigns can generate trusted multi-physics corpora without reinventing the pipeline every time
* Make Large Physics Foundation Models operationally real for product teams, so they can ship models that customers trust and that survive contact with production workflows
* Establish reproducible training runs and physics-based evaluation standards that ensure models fail gracefully and teams know the bounds of what they can and cannot predict
* Support product integrations that let downstream engineers call your models without needing to understand the ML stack, just the physics constraints that matter for their workflow

### **What You'll Need**

* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field (PhD welcome but not required)
* 2-3+ years building ML systems in production, with meaningful time spent on large scientific datasets, simulation data, HPC environments, or deploying models beyond notebooks
* Strong Python engineering habits: testing, versioning, CI/CD, API design, and operability of long-running jobs
* Hands-on deep learning experience with PyTorch or equivalent, including data loaders for irregular 3D data, distributed training, and checkpointing
* Experience with transformers, vision-language models, neural operators, geometric deep learning, graph networks, or physics surrogates is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ability to own work across ambiguous boundaries between data engineering, model training, and product deployment

### **Who You Are**

* You close gaps instead of waiting for someone else to define the interface. If the data pipeline does not exist, you build it. If the deployment story is unclear, you figure it out with the product team.
* Scientific honesty matters to you. You quarantine bad simulations, report what the model does not predict, and own the bounds of failure instead of overselling what works.
* You defer to specialists on what you do not know and collaborate effectively with product engineers who will live with your deployment long after you hand it off.
* You can explain a technical tradeoff to a product manager in two sentences without losing the nuance, and you can debug a distributed training failure at 3am when the run is 80% done.
* You think in systems, not just models. The checkpoint is not the finish line. Packaging, serving, versioning, and supportability are part of the job, and you treat them that way.

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

The team's job is to make Large Physics Foundation Models real for CFD, Icepak, and HFSS. Research defines the architectures and learning objectives. This engineering seat makes the data and the runtime real. You will work with specialists who understand the physics deeply, product teams who know what customers need, and other ML engineers who care about building systems that scale. The core mission has three parts: reuse and scale dataset factories so campaigns produce large, clean, 3D physics corpora; train large models on that data with reproducible runs and physics-based evaluation; and deploy and support those models so product teams can integrate them, operate them, and trust their limits.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Snap Analytics is a specialist data and AI consultancy that designs and engineers modern cloud data platforms for large enterprises. Founded in Bristol in 2019, we’re best known for our deep SAP expertise combined with modern platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran, dbt and AWS. Our engineering operates at the edge of machine intelligence—fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), engineering Large Foundation Models (LFMs), and deploying autonomous multi-agent systems that solve complex, multi-step business logic.

From deploying high-impact adaptive platforms that reach thousands of users to solving high-stakes enterprise workflows, we bridge the gap between speculative AI research and deterministic business value. Led by technologists from premier institutions, NeuraMach.AI is where obsessive engineers build what’s next—and where forward-thinking enterprises make AI their unfair competitive advantage.

**Our production platforms are live. Now we are focused on:**

* Strengthening production reliability across mission-critical workflows
* Improving engineering quality, architecture simplicity, and release discipline
* Building reusable, scalable AI agents and platform capabilities
* Expanding autonomous multi-agent systems to higher-throughput environments
* Creating a high-accountability, high-velocity engineering organisation

This is a founding role because we're still building the engineering execution function, ownership model, and future technical team. We need a senior engineering leader who can work directly with our CTO and make the technology deliver on the ground, every single day.

**Your Mandate**

As our Founding Engineering Lead, you will translate technology direction into strong implementation, predictable delivery, and reliable production systems.

**You will:**

**1.** Review critical architecture and codebases in depth

**2.** Guide high-stakes technical and implementation decisions

**3.** Resolve production bottlenecks and delivery risks

**4.** Coordinate core engineers, specialists, and technical contributors

**5.** Establish production-grade engineering and release standards

**6.** Improve accountability across the technical organization

**7.** Convert ambitious AI research and technical plans into deterministic, working platforms

**8.** This is a hands-on execution role for someone who wants to build, guide, and ship at scale.

**Your First Six Months:**

* Establish the Technical Reality
* Review the architecture, codebase, cloud infrastructure, multi-agent workflows, data pipelines, security controls, technical debt, and team ownership.
* Turn findings into a prioritised, high-impact execution roadmap.
* Identify what must be fixed, what should be simplified, and what is strong enough to scale without rewrite overhead.

**Stabilise Critical Workflows**

**Take direct engineering ownership across high-impact systems:**

* Authentication, authorization, and zero-trust security controls
* High-throughput payload processing and backend services
* Autonomous agent orchestration, execution, and state handling
* Multi-model LLM/LFM routing, context management, and fallback mechanisms
* Vector storage, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and hybrid search pipelines
* Real-time telemetry, session handling, and platform analytics
* Billing, access management, and subscription systems
* OpenTelemetry-based logging, monitoring, and incident response
* Ensure all user-facing and high-stakes enterprise workflows are reliable, observable, and strictly owned.
* Build Engineering Discipline

**Establish practical standards for:**

* Code and architecture reviews
* Automated testing and continuous integration (CI/CD)
* Technical documentation and API contracts
* Security assessments and vulnerability management
* Performance tracking and latency optimization
* Post-mortem incident ownership and root-cause resolution
* Systematic technical-debt tracking

**Strengthen the Agentic AI Platform**

**Work alongside the CTO and AI contributors to improve:**

* Multi-model LLM/LFM orchestration and autonomous agent routing
* Hybrid search, vector retrieval (Qdrant), and reranking precision
* Context window management and memory persistence
* Prompt engineering, configuration versioning, and policy guardrails
* AI evaluation, benchmarking, and deterministic verification frameworks
* Latency reduction and model inference cost optimization
* Full-stack AI telemetry and agent observability

**Lead Engineering Execution**

* Lead a lean mix of internal engineers and external specialists across product, cloud, and AI engineering.
* Clarify service ownership, coordinate releases, mentor engineers, and address technical hiring gaps.
* Balance system breadth with technical depth—combining strong engineering judgment with the ability to build specialist-driven teams.

**What You Will Own**

**In close partnership with the CTO, you will own day-to-day engineering execution across:**

* Architecture implementation and system delivery
* Code quality, test coverage, and release predictability
* Production readiness, uptime, and system reliability
* Standard operating procedures for incident management
* Technical documentation and system specs
* Team execution velocity and accountability
* Vendor, contractor, and partner coordination
* Technical hiring, candidate evaluation, and team building

You will hold direct authority to challenge decisions that introduce unnecessary risk, delay, cost, or architectural complexity.

**Technology Foundation Core Stack**

**1. Frontend/Services:** React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, FastAPI

**2. Databases & Caching:** PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant

**3. Networking & Integration:** REST, WebSockets, gRPC, and real-time service patterns

**4. AWS Cloud & DevOps:** AWS (Cognito, S3, SQS, EC2, Lambda), Docker, GitHub Actions

**5. AI Engine:** Frontier LLM/LFM integrations, fine-tuned models, vector databases, multi-agent orchestrators

**Systems Being Strengthened**

* Autonomous multi-agent orchestration and dynamic agent routing
* RAG, hybrid retrieval, and knowledge graph integrations
* AI evaluation, deterministic benchmarks, and behavioral telemetry
* OpenTelemetry-based observability and performance tracking
* Infrastructure and model inference cost visibility
* Automated testing pipelines and zero-downtime release strategies
* Fine-grained security access controls and recovery mechanisms

Technologies such as Kafka, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Spark, Kong, or Kubernetes/EKS are introduced or expanded strictly when operational demands and high throughput justify them.

**What Success Looks Like (12-Month Horizon)**

* A clear architecture mapping and defined service-ownership model
* A prioritized, actively managed technical-debt register
* Production ownership established across all core agent and platform workflows
* A predictable release pipeline supported by automated test suites
* Standardized incident response, monitoring, and zero-downtime recovery controls
* Rigorous AI quality, latency, and model cost benchmarks
* Full observability across cloud infrastructure and model pipelines
* Hardened security access controls and cost-efficient cloud utilization
* Modular, reusable platform foundations ready for multi-market enterprise scale
* Reduced dependency on individual contributors through robust documentation and processes

**Qualification Profile**

**You are an ideal fit if:**

* You have owned high-throughput, mission-critical systems in a zero-to-one or high-growth startup environment.
* You have led engineering teams while remaining deeply hands-on with architecture and code.
* You possess strong technical depth across modern backend systems, cloud-native architectures (AWS), and frontend frameworks.
* You are highly experienced with Python, Node.js, TypeScript, and modern API/data protocols.
* You have hands-on experience building LLM applications, autonomous agentic workflows, fine-tuning techniques, vector search, or AI orchestration.
* You design explicitly for reliability, maintainability, low latency, and cost efficiency.
* You have practical experience with CI/CD, containerization, cloud infrastructure, OpenTelemetry, and incident management.
* You actively seek to simplify complex, over-engineered architectures.
* You evaluate technical decisions through the lens of business value and real-world execution.
* You are adaptable, thrive in high-autonomy environments, and excel under ambiguity.
* Prior domain experience in enterprise AI, SaaS, data platforms, or cloud infrastructure is highly desirable. This role is exceptionally suited for former technical founders, senior startup architects, or engineering leaders seeking a founding stake.

**Compensation & Commitment**

This is an ESOP-led founding leadership role.

**Fixed Salary:** No fixed monthly salary during the current stage.

**Salary Commencement:** Fixed compensation will kick off upon completing a target fundraising round or reaching self-sustaining revenue capable of supporting leadership payroll.

**Equity:** Shortlisted candidates will receive full transparency into the indicative ESOP structure, vesting terms, commitment milestones, and salary-trigger conditions during initial executive discussions.

**Performance Incentives:** Additional performance-linked equity grants or incentives will be evaluated based on execution benchmarks.

There is no fixed timeline for fundraising or profitability. This role requires an entrepreneurial commitment driven by ownership, high agency, and long-term equity upside.

**This Role Is Not For You If:**

* You require an immediate, guaranteed fixed salary.
* You prefer managing large, established teams over building systems from the ground up.
* You require significant infrastructure budgets before executing.
* You favor high-level strategy presentations over direct code reviews and shipping product.
* You are uncomfortable with fast-paced startup ambiguity and high accountability.

**How to Apply**

Send the following details directly to Dimpal@NeuraMach.AI or Rutuja@NeuraMach.AI

title: Field Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

As a Field Engineer you will embed directly with clients to architect and build mission-critical integrations, automations, and data solutions. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you will serve as Addepar's technical vanguard - translating complex business requirements into production-grade systems while driving onboarding efficiency and operational scale. You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling - solving our clients' most challenging problems. This role combines a forward-deployed model with deep technical expertise in modern software engineering and financial data systems.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Deploy directly to client sites (virtual or in-person) to architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
* Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
* Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
* Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
* Write production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
* Lead technical workstreams end-to-end, from requirements gathering through production deployment, owning outcomes and client success
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence platform roadmap
* Develop internal tools, frameworks, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the broader team
* Effectively set, manage, and communicate technical expectations with both client stakeholders and internal cross-functional teams
* Prioritize and context-switch effectively across simultaneous client engagements, seeing each through to successful completion
* Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

#### **Who You Are**

* Minimum 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles
* Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks
* Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
* Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations
* Familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
* Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset and bias for action
* Outstanding communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
* Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards
* Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
* Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for client impact
* Strong work ethic, proactive approach, and high contributing teammate

**Our Values**

* **Act Like an Owner -** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together -** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients -** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation -** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning -** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

Location: Pune, India

About Kadel Labs

Kadel Labs is a deep-tech IT services company established in 2017, specializing in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Operations, Information Security, Software Development, Modernization, and Generative AI solutions. We help organizations build scalable, secure, and reliable technology solutions.

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI) Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of build and release management, hardware certification, and infrastructure engineering for an HCI platform.

The role combines embedded systems development, cloud-native integrations, build and release ownership, and hardware-software validation. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience across compute, storage, networking, and hardware acceleration, ensuring reliable, secure, and enterprise-ready builds.

Key Responsibilities

1. Build and Release Management

* Maintain, monitor, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for HCI software components.

* Troubleshoot build failures and ensure build reliability and availability.

* Perform vulnerability scans and integrate security checks into the build process.

* Collaborate with development teams to resolve build issues and maintain secure coding practices.

2. HCI Hardware Certification and Validation

* Validate HCI platforms across server, storage, and network hardware vendors.

* Perform interoperability, firmware compatibility, and compliance testing.

* Certify performance and reliability across OEM platforms such as Dell, HPE, and Cisco.

* Execute benchmarking, regression, chaos, and resiliency testing for enterprise workloads.

3. Infrastructure and Platform Engineering

* Enhance and maintain the HCI stack across compute, storage, and networking.

* Develop and optimize high-performance I/O paths, storage acceleration, and networking offloads.

* Integrate custom hardware with Kubernetes using CRDs, CSI/CNI drivers, and Operators.

* Perform scalability and performance tuning under production-like workloads.

* Use Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Pulumi for consistent deployments.

4. Collaboration and Support

* Collaborate with Product Management to define technical requirements and customer use cases.

* Support QA and Support teams in troubleshooting and resolving escalations.

* Participate in Proof of Concept (PoC) deployments and customer-facing solution validation.

* Coordinate with hardware vendors and certification bodies to ensure compliance.

5. Documentation and Code Quality

* Document build processes, certification procedures, and infrastructure deployments.

* Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and architecture improvements.

* Maintain high code quality through unit, integration, and automation test coverage.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

* 6+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, embedded systems, or hardware certification.

* Strong programming skills in C, C++, Go, and Shell scripting.

* Experience with Linux kernel internals, performance tuning, and driver development.

* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including CSI/CNI driver development, Operators, Helm, and container runtimes.

* Knowledge of storage technologies such as NVMe, NVMe-oF, iSCSI, Fibre Channel, and distributed storage systems.

* Understanding of networking technologies, including VLANs, SDN, SR-IOV, DPDK, and NIC offloads.

* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions.

* Familiarity with Ansible, Terraform, and Pulumi.

* Experience with hardware integration, including PCIe devices, BIOS/UEFI, firmware upgrades, BMC, iLO, and iDRAC.

* Knowledge of debugging and security tools such as GDB, logic analyzers, JTAG, Snyk, Trivy, and SonarQube.

Good to Have

* Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio and Linkerd.

* Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as FIPS, FedRAMP, and PCI-DSS.

* Experience with secure Kubernetes operations and OPA/Gatekeeper.

* Exposure to chaos testing and infrastructure validation automation frameworks.

* Experience with multi-cluster management platforms such as Spektra, Rancher, Anthos, or OpenShift.

* Strong communication and mentoring skills.

* Certifications such as CKA or CKAD.

* Contributions to open-source projects involving Kubernetes, the Linux kernel, or storage.

* Familiarity with hardware debugging tools and testing frameworks.

What We Offer

* The opportunity to own end-to-end build management, infrastructure engineering, and hardware certification.

* Exposure to embedded systems and cloud-native orchestration technologies.

* The opportunity to contribute to enterprise-grade HCI platforms for mission-critical workloads.

* Collaboration with experts in systems programming, Kubernetes, and hardware-software integration.

title: Principal, Security Development & Automation
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Principal, Security Development & Automation is a senior technical contributor who helps protect Northern Trust by engineering automation-first security capabilities. This role is responsible for designing and delivering AI-enabled workflows, API integrations, playbooks, scripts and platform services that strengthen cyber defense, reduce manual operational burden and make security outcomes more consistent, measurable and repeatable. The Principal Partner works across security engineering, operations, infrastructure, application, risk, audit and technology teams to identify high-value security workflows, translate them into automation patterns and deliver solutions that improve control execution, threat response, vulnerability management, evidence collection and operational resilience.

**What You'll Do**

***Protect Northern Trust Through Security Driven Development and Automation***

* Build development and automation capabilities that help protect Northern Trust’s technology environment, reduce cyber risk and improve the consistency of security execution.
* Engineer AI agent-based workflows that support security triage, enrichment, correlation, investigation support, evidence collection, control validation and remediation orchestration.
* Create secure API integrations across security platforms, ITSM, CMDB, vulnerability management, cloud, network, identity, data and observability tools to connect signals, decisions and actions.
* Develop reliable workflow automation assets that remove friction from security operations and make high-value controls easier to operate at scale.
* Partner with security architecture, platform engineering, cloud security, IAM, threat and governance teams to create reusable automation standards, secure engineering patterns, guardrails and operational handoffs.

***Key Deliverables***

* Own development and automation capabilities that help Northern Trust protect critical services and data, including:

– Security workflow automation that accelerates discovery, response, remediation and control validation

– API integrations and reusable playbooks that connect security platforms, enterprise data sources and operational systems of record

– AI-enabled assistants and agents that improve security decision support while respecting enterprise controls, approvals and data protection requirements

– Design and Build LLM-based vulnerability scanning and remediation solutions.

* Integrate LLM capabilities responsibly using enterprise AI platforms such as AI Foundry, approved model providers and vendor AI harnesses to enhance—not replace—security judgment and control execution.
* Develop prompt, retrieval, orchestration, testing and evaluation patterns that make AI-enabled workflows reliable, observable, secure and aligned to enterprise policy.
* Engineer automation with strong authentication, authorization, secrets handling, logging, exception handling, change control and auditability so solutions can be trusted in production security workflows.
* Document architecture, runbooks, decision logic, reusable patterns and operational handoffs so capabilities can be supported, governed and improved over time.
* Influence platform roadmaps, vendor integrations and automation priorities based on risk reduction, control effectiveness, resiliency, stability and reuse.
* Mentor junior team members

**What You'll Bring**

* 15+ years of experience in cybersecurity, software engineering, security automation, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation or related technology disciplines.
* Strong understanding of how development and automation can be used to protect enterprise environments, improve control execution and reduce operational risk.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a principal-level technical partner: setting direction, influencing architecture, mentoring engineers, leading complex technical delivery and driving adoption across teams without relying on direct authority.
* Hands-on development skills in Python, including API consumption, data transformation, automation frameworks, error handling, testing and operational supportability.
* Experience integrating security, ITSM, cloud, identity, observability or data platforms through REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, workflow tools or orchestration platforms.
* Working knowledge of LLM-enabled solution patterns, AI agent workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, AI guardrails and secure use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Ability to deliver in a regulated environment with strong attention to audit-ready evidence, access controls, change management, testability, resiliency and production support.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in financial services, banking, asset servicing, wealth management or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflows, Vulnerability Response, SecOps, CMDB, ITSM integrations or similar enterprise workflow platforms.
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines or cloud-native automation patterns.
* Experience building automation for vulnerability management, exposure management, threat response, identity security, network security or cloud security operations.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Senior Java Engineer - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

This Senior Java Engineer role is a senior-level software engineering position embedded within Citi's Exchange-Traded Derivatives (ETD) Clearing technology organization, responsible for building and modernizing strategic, business-critical capabilities across a global clearing infrastructure. The position sits at the intersection of hands-on Java development, cloud-native architecture, and large-scale distributed systems supporting real-time message flows from global futures markets while contributing to the replacement of legacy product processors. The ideal candidate will bring deep enterprise engineering expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and a demonstrated commitment to AI-assisted software development practices. This role offers a compelling opportunity to help shape the future of a mission-critical capital markets platform at one of the world's leading global financial institutions.

  
  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

  
  

* Deliver strategic initiatives within the ETD Clearing portfolio using Agile methodologies, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.
* Design and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native applications, APIs, and services aligned with Citi's architecture and engineering standards.
* Perform hands-on Java-based development and provide L3 production support for the core ETD Clearing platform, including real-time message flows from global futures markets.
* Contribute to platform transformation efforts, including the replacement of legacy product processors and the adoption of modern cloud, containerization, and distributed systems technologies.
* Leverage and promote the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering tools to accelerate development cycles, automate processes, and improve troubleshooting efficiency.
* Establish and maintain CI/CD, DevOps, and observability practices to enhance platform stability, reliability, and time-to-market.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across global regions including Pune, India and with ETD technology teams to coordinate release planning and delivery.
* Collaborate with and support junior and mid-level engineers by sharing technical knowledge, contributing to best practices, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration across engineering, QA, product, and business teams to deliver high-quality, reusable enterprise capabilities.
* Identify and address technical risk, application health, and regulatory compliance requirements in alignment with Citi's standards for client and asset protection.
* Drive engineering excellence through automation, testability, reusability, and operational rigor across the full software development lifecycle.
  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

  
  

* 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale applications in complex, global environments.
* Deep expertise in Java-based application development, including Spring Boot, microservices architecture, and distributed systems design.
* Hands-on experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Solace in high-throughput, low-latency environments.

Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.

To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our Careers Page.

**What You'll Do:**

LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.

Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!

LogicMonitor is redefining observability through **Edwin AI**, our GenAI-powered AIOps platform that helps engineering and operations teams understand, investigate, and resolve issues faster across complex hybrid environments. Edwin AI brings together telemetry, topology, alerts, metrics, logs, traces, incidents, and operational context with the reasoning capabilities of large language models.

We're looking for a **Senior AI Engineer** to design, build, evaluate, and operate the AI systems that power Edwin's intelligence. This role sits at the intersection of applied machine learning, LLM application engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, data intelligence, and production software engineering.

You will build AI workflows that transform complex observability signals into clear summaries, correlations, root-cause hypotheses, anomaly explanations, recommendations, and guided remediation steps. You'll work closely with AI Platform, Backend, Data, AIOps, SRE, Product, and Design teams to make Edwin accurate, reliable, explainable, secure, and impactful for customers.

**Here's a closer look at this key role:**

  

* Design and build AI capabilities for **Edwin AI**, including incident summarization, alert correlation, anomaly explanation, root-cause analysis assistance, recommendation generation, and guided remediation workflows.
* Develop production-grade LLM applications using techniques such as **retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, function calling, prompt orchestration, agentic workflows, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning pipelines**.
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines that retrieve relevant observability context from metrics, logs, traces, alerts, topology, incidents, runbooks, knowledge bases, and historical operational data.
* Design embedding, indexing, chunking, reranking, query expansion, and semantic retrieval strategies for high-scale observability and AIOps use cases.
* Develop AI orchestration services using **Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks**.
* Implement structured AI workflows that combine deterministic business logic, statistical methods, retrieval systems, and LLM reasoning.
* Collaborate with backend and data engineering teams to define AI-ready data contracts, metadata schemas, context formats, and retrieval APIs.
* Build evaluation frameworks for AI quality, including relevance, groundedness, correctness, hallucination reduction, latency, cost, safety, and user usefulness.
* Create offline and online evaluation pipelines using golden datasets, synthetic test cases, human review, A/B testing, feedback loops, and production telemetry.
* Optimize prompt templates, model selection, retrieval strategies, context windows, latency, token usage, cost, and response consistency.
* Implement guardrails for safe and trustworthy AI behavior, including source attribution, citation handling, confidence signals, output validation, policy checks, and fallback strategies.
* Work with structured and unstructured observability data to power AI reasoning across events, incidents, alerts, logs, metrics, topology, and service dependencies.
* Integrate with commercial and open-source LLMs, embedding models, rerankers, vector databases, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Build APIs and services that expose AI capabilities to Edwin's UI, backend systems, and AIOps workflows.
* Instrument AI pipelines with observability, tracing, metrics, structured logs, evaluation signals, and debugging tools.
* Partner with SRE and platform teams to monitor production AI behavior, troubleshoot failures, and improve reliability across end-to-end AI workflows.
* Collaborate with Product and Design to shape AI UX patterns such as citations, reasoning summaries, confidence indicators, feedback capture, explainability, and human-in-the-loop interactions.
* Ensure model inputs, retrieved context, generated outputs, and stored AI artifacts follow data privacy, RBAC, tenant isolation, and compliance requirements.
* Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, code reviews, and AI best-practice development.
* Mentor engineers on LLM application patterns, RAG design, evaluation methods, and production AI engineering practices.

**What You'll Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, or backend systems.
* Strong programming skills in **Python**, with experience building production-grade services, APIs, pipelines, or AI applications.
* Experience building LLM-powered applications using **RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, or agentic workflows**.
* Hands-on experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as **LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex**, or similar technologies.
* Experience with model APIs and platforms such as **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI**, or open-source model-serving stacks.
* Strong understanding of retrieval systems, semantic search, chunking strategies, embeddings, metadata filtering, reranking, query rewriting, and context assembly.
* Experience building evaluation pipelines for LLM applications, including test datasets, human review workflows, automated scoring, and production feedback loops.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including API design, testing, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and secure coding practices.
* Experience working with distributed systems, data pipelines, streaming systems, or large-scale operational data.
* Familiarity with vector databases or search systems such as **pgvector, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant**, or similar technologies.
* Experience with containers, Kubernetes, cloud-native deployment, and production service operations.
* Understanding of AI safety, data privacy, RBAC, tenant isolation, prompt injection risks, grounding, hallucination mitigation, and secure handling of customer data.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with AI Platform, Backend, Data, SRE, Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain AI behavior, quality tradeoffs, and technical implementation details clearly.

title: Product Associate
description:
**Job Role - Product Associate**

**Location - Pune**

  

**What the work is like**

Nobody will hand you a finished spec. You'll get a customer with a problem, a rough idea of what good looks like, and

people who will help if you ask. You talk to the customer, work out what is actually wrong, decide what to build, get it

built (with engineers, or with AI tools yourself), and check that it worked. Then you do the next one.

You'll own one area of the product and the customers who use it. We decide which area together, once you've joined,

based on what you're good at.

  

**You'll do well here if**

* You've started something nobody asked you to: a project, a small business, an event, a fix at work, an app
* When instructions are unclear, you make a sensible assumption, say it out loud, and get moving
* You'd rather ship something that works on Friday than something perfect next month
* You go and ask the person with the problem instead of guessing
* You pick up new things quickly, whether that's a new industry, a codebase or a customer's business

  

**You probably won't enjoy it if**

* You do your best work when the task is fully defined before you start
* You want a large team and a fixed process around you

  

**What we don't require**

A particular degree or college, a product title, or years of experience. Some of our best people came from customer

support, operations or a family business.

  

**How to apply**

We don't start with your CV. The application form asks for:

1. A link to something you built, ran or fixed that nobody asked you to. Any form counts: an app, a spreadsheet,

an event, a process, a video.

2. What was broken, what you did, and what happened. At most 100 words, with at least one real name, number

or date.

3. One time nobody told you what to do. What did you do in the first hour? At most 100 words.

4. When you can start, and a link to your CV or LinkedIn.

  

Applications without a link, or with answers over 100 words, are not read. The limits are part of the test.

Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfKHxjoKx3sOvBijnnloJQqE3ywMJpyP9T0GoR7\_kB\_5FKQfQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=104777260577875084657

  

What happens next: a 30-minute written exercise, a 20-minute call, a take-home (AI tools allowed) and a conversation about

it, then a final conversation with our CEO.

  

**About CrelioHealth**  
CrelioHealth is a fast-growing health-tech product company delivering cloud-based LIMS, RIS, CRM, and Inventory solutions to diagnostics labs and hospitals globally. We are building scalable systems that power modern healthcare operations.  
  
**Website**: www.creliohealth.com

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Security & DevSecOps Engineer to strengthen the security posture of cloud-native and hybrid environments. * Drive security best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay updated with evolving cloud security threats, technologies, and industry standards.

title: Software Engineering, Staff
description:
Overview:

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

The Role and Team

At Medallia, our Nexus Collection & Data Platform team builds and operates the critical backend services that power how surveys are executed, distributed, processed, and collected across Nexus, Medallia’s next-generation experience management platform.

Our systems sit at the core of Nexus’s data platform and support large-scale, highly available workloads across many enterprise customers. The team owns services and capabilities related to survey execution, distribution, response processing, webhooks, messaging integrations, and the streaming pipelines that turn raw collection events into reliable, reportable data.

As Nexus continues to scale, we are evolving these systems to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency while building out key parts of the platform from the ground up on a modern, cloud-native stack.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer who enjoys solving challenging backend and distributed systems problems, working with high-throughput streaming services, and building reliable software that operates at enterprise scale. You will work closely with experienced engineers, Product Management, QA, and other platform teams to design and deliver capabilities that directly impact how millions of surveys and responses are processed across Nexus.  
  
This role is based remotely in Pune. Candidates for this position are required to reside within the Pune metropolitan area. Relocation support is not available at this time.

Responsibilities:  

* Drive resolution on open, cross-cutting architectural questions — Nexus has several live ones at any given time (e.g., which store owns a given workload and why, how a materialization strategy should be chosen and validated, how a new enrichment type should integrate without violating existing invariants). You're expected to drive these to a documented, defensible decision — not just have an opinion on them.
* Own the integrity of the platform's core data invariants across teams — multi-tenant isolation via the composite entity key model, the rule that enrichments never rewrite interaction data, and that row-level access is enforced on views rather than scattered through application logic. When a new feature threatens one of these, you're the engineer who catches it before it ships.
* Design the pipeline and schema evolution patterns other teams build against — e.g., how a dataset schema can evolve without migrations or downtime, how a new interaction type gets onboarded, how an enrichment's output reaches reporting without duplicating or destabilizing existing views.  
  Lead technical design for major cross-team initiatives — examples at this scale: extending the platform to ingest data originating from Medallia's existing products (MEC) alongside Nexus-native data, designing how AI agents (survey-building assistants, conversational feedback collection) integrate with the core data model via MCP/A2A without becoming a second, inconsistent source of truth.
* Evaluate and make build-vs-buy and store-selection decisions with real stakes — e.g., assessing whether a given workload belongs on a relational store, a wide-column store, or an OLAP engine, and what the actual operational and consistency trade-offs are, backed by a POC or benchmark rather than a hunch.
* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, data modeling for multi-tenant correctness, and how to reason about trade-offs in a system where "simple and wrong" fails silently and expensively.
* Represent engineering in architecture and design reviews across team boundaries, and be a primary author of the architecture documentation the rest of the organization builds against.
* Get hands-on when it matters — staff-level scope doesn't mean stepping back from code. You'll personally build the hardest, highest-leverage pieces of a cross-cutting initiative, especially where the design risk is too high to hand off before it's proven out.
* Improve how the platform is operated at scale — reliability, observability, and incident response patterns that work across both the application and data layers, not just within one service's boundary.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, and set the bar for how your teams evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and long-term maintainability.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership beyond your own individual contributions — driving decisions, designs, or initiatives that other engineers and teams built on top of.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems — you can reason rigorously about consistency models, failure modes, data consistency guarantees, and the real trade-offs behind an architectural decision, not just the vocabulary.
* Strong backend engineering background, ideally spanning more than one language/stack (e.g., Java and TypeScript/Node.js, or equivalent) — this role operates across Nexus Core and the Data Platform, and needs to be credible in both.
* Demonstrated experience with event-driven and streaming architectures (Kafka or equivalent, plus a stream processor such as Flink, Spark Streaming, or Kafka Streams).
* Deep experience with relational and/or wide-column data stores at scale, including schema design for systems that can't tolerate downtime or destructive changes.
* Proven experience designing for multi-tenant SaaS correctness — tenant isolation, authorization models, and the discipline required when a design mistake doesn't just cause a bug, it causes a data leak between customers.
* A track record of making and defending hard technical trade-off decisions in writing — RFCs, design docs, or equivalent — and bringing skeptical stakeholders to alignment.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction without direct management authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — at this level, your technical judgment is only as useful as your ability to convey it clearly to engineers, product, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience designing row-level or policy-based authorization systems, especially ones enforced at the data/view layer rather than purely in application code.
* Experience with identity resolution systems — matching, merging, and the operational cost of getting profile/entity resolution wrong at scale.
* Experience integrating LLM-based agents or tools into a production platform, especially using protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) or agent-to-agent (A2A) coordination.
* Experience leading a platform migration or hybrid-integration effort — e.g., bringing a legacy system's data into a new platform without forcing customers through a disruptive migration.
* Background in customer experience management, survey platforms, or voice-of-customer systems.
* Experience as a technical lead on a greenfield platform build, with scars to show for the early architectural bets that worked and the ones that didn't.  
    
  At Medallia, we celebrate diversity and recognize the value it brings to our customers and employees. Medallia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, genetic information, veteran status or military service, or any other status protected by state or local law. Individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to apply please contact us at ApplicantAccessibility@medallia.com. For information regarding how Medallia collects and uses personal information, please review our Privacy Policies. Applications will be accepted for 30 days from the date this role was posted or until the role has been filled.

title: Engineering Architect
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Architect to lead the design and development of enterprise-scale Generative AI platforms, Agentic AI frameworks, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Python, FastAPI, Large Language Models (LLMs), cloud-native architectures, and AI engineering best practices.

  

* **Role: Engineering Architect – GenAI, FastAPI & Python**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 12 to 16 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Architect and develop scalable Python and FastAPI-based microservices supporting AI, RAG, and GenAI workloads.
* Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks for enterprise AI applications.
* Define ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounding strategies for AI systems.
* Build Agentic AI frameworks incorporating tool-calling, autonomous workflows, guardrails, and policy enforcement mechanisms.
* Design reusable AI accelerators, SDKs, frameworks, libraries, and development templates.
* Architect and optimize Vector Database solutions using pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, OpenSearch, or Elasticsearch.
* Evaluate and integrate Large Language Models and foundation models based on business requirements, performance, governance, and cost considerations.
* Implement enterprise-grade security, authentication, authorization, governance, and compliance standards across AI platforms.
* Design cloud-native AI architectures leveraging AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform services.
* Develop robust CI/CD pipelines for AI applications and microservices deployments.
* Implement containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Build monitoring, observability, telemetry, logging, and operational support capabilities using OpenTelemetry and modern observability platforms.
* Drive performance tuning, scalability improvements, and optimization of AI systems.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Enterprise Architects to define AI roadmaps and solution strategies.
* Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical mentoring initiatives.
* Support AI platform adoption and promote engineering best practices across teams.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 12-16 years of experience in Software Engineering, Solution Architecture, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Architecture.
* Strong expertise in Python development and enterprise application design.
* Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
* Proven experience designing and deploying Generative AI and LLM-powered applications.
* Experience building Agentic AI frameworks and autonomous AI workflows.
* Deep understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and implementation patterns.
* Experience with embeddings, semantic search, vector retrieval, reranking, and contextual grounding techniques.
* Hands-on experience with Vector Databases such as pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch / Elasticsearch.
* Experience integrating and deploying Large Language Models through Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Hugging Face Models, Open-source LLMs.
* Expertise in cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, and distributed systems.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data protection, and AI governance principles.
* Knowledge of performance optimization, caching strategies, scalability, and high-availability architectures.
* Experience designing reusable frameworks and enterprise architecture patterns.
* Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and technical leadership capabilities.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
