### **Description and Requirements**

The MetLife EMEA Technology organization is evolving to enable MetLife’s New Frontier strategy. With a strong vision in place, we are a function focused on driving digital technology strategies for key technology functions within MetLife including. In partnership with our business leaders, we develop and deliver seamless technology experiences to our employees across the entire employee lifecycle. Our vision and mission is to create innovative, transformative and contemporary technology solutions to empower our leaders and employees so they can focus on what matters most, our customers. We are technologists with strong business acumen focused on developing our talent to continually transform and innovate.

  
  

We are seeking a skilled **Software Platform Engineer (AS400 / COBOL)** to support and modernize critical business applications within the Egypt market. This role is part of the AS400 team and will work closely with a Senior Software Engineer to ensure the stability, performance, and continuous evolution of core insurance platforms. The selected candidate will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and support of AS400-based systems while supporting MetLife’s broader digital transformation agenda.

  
  

The role requires a hands-on engineer with strong technical knowledge, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to operate in a high-dependency environment where reliability, ownership, knowledge sharing, and Agile ways of working are essential.

  
  

**Key Relationships:**

Senior Software Engineer and AS400 Team, Technology Leadership in Egypt and EMEA, Business Product Owners and Stakeholders, Agile Release Train (ART) Teams, Scrum Master, Product Owner, Infrastructure and Platform Teams, and external vendors and partners where applicable.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain COBOL-based applications on AS400 / IBM i-Series platforms.

* Ensure high availability, performance, and stability of business-critical production systems.

* Take ownership of assigned tasks and system components, including incident analysis, root cause identification, and continuous improvement, working closely with the Senior Software Engineer where required.

* Collaborate with business, product, engineering, and Agile team members to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

* Support end-to-end delivery, including development, testing, deployment, and post-production support.

* Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and architectural decisions as part of the AS400 team.

* Support production deployments and critical releases, helping ensure minimal disruption to business operations.

* Drive knowledge documentation and transfer to reduce single points of failure within the organization.

* Contribute to modernization initiatives, integration efforts, and optimization of legacy systems.

* Work as part of Agile teams, actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, estimations, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and delivery of user stories.

  
  

**Operating Model & Working Conditions:**

* This role supports the Egypt business and follows Sunday to Thursday working days, with standard working hours aligned to Egypt business hours.

* Production deployments and critical releases are typically scheduled during weekends, Friday and Saturday.

* Flexibility is required, as working hours may vary depending on project needs, releases, and production support activities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* 4-6 years of hands-on software engineering and production experience.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

* Strong hands-on experience in COBOL programming and IBM AS400 / IBM i-Series platforms.

* Proven experience in production support and incident management for critical systems.

* Solid understanding of application design, architecture, system integration, and data flows.

* Experience working as part of Agile teams and following Agile ways of working.

* Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and collaboration tools is a plus.

* Prior experience in the insurance or financial services domain is highly preferred.

  
  

**Technical Capabilities:**

  

* AS400 / IBM i-Series ecosystem, including CL and RPG as required capabilities.

* COBOL development and maintenance.

* Batch processing and job scheduling.

* System performance tuning and optimization.

* Integration with external systems and platforms.

* Understanding of cloud and hybrid architectures is an advantage.

* Application design and architecture.

* DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and collaboration tools.

  
  

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.

* Clear and effective communication skills.

* High level of accountability and ownership.

* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within the AS400 team and Agile delivery teams.

* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

* Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

  
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Stable and reliable operation of AS400-based critical systems.

* Reduced dependency on single individuals through proper documentation and knowledge sharing.

* Efficient handling of incidents with minimal business disruption.

* Continuous enhancement and optimization of legacy platforms.

* Strong alignment with business needs, Agile team commitments, sprint goals, and delivery timelines.

  
  
  

**About MetLife**  
  

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.  
  

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value.

  

Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s #AllTogetherPossible. Join us!

The Digital S/W Engineer Sr Analyst Shape, build, and govern high-impact API solutions as a Senior Systems Engineer, sitting at the intersection of hands-on Apigee development and API design leadership within Citi's Digital Engineering organization. In this hybrid technical role, you will both develop and configure production API solutions on Google Apigee and lead the design and specification of API interfaces and integration patterns — owning mid-size features end-to-end from architecture through deployment, while contributing to larger platform initiatives.

  
  

You will be equally comfortable configuring Apigee proxies and policies as you are producing API design artefacts, leading design reviews, and governing integration standards. This role sits within Citi's Wealth Digital engineering team, where your contributions will directly shape API quality, security posture, and delivery outcomes at scale.

  
  

Responsibilities

  
  

Apigee

* Design and configure API proxies on Google Apigee, including proxy configurations, flow definitions, route rules, and target endpoint setup.

* Define and maintain Apigee policies — including traffic management (quota, spike arrest, rate limiting), mediation (JSON-to-XML, message transformation), and security (OAuth, API key validation, JWT verification) policies.

* Implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) authorization flows natively within Apigee, including authorization code, client credentials, and token introspection patterns.

* Configure and manage Apigee environments, API products, developer portals, and monetization configurations in line with platform governance standards.

* Integrate Apigee with backend services, identity providers, and downstream systems through secure, performant target configurations.

  
  

API Design & Governance

* Lead the design and specification of RESTful APIs, producing OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, API contracts, and integration specifications that engineering teams implement against.

* Apply Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles in both API design specifications and Apigee proxy configurations to protect sensitive financial data exchanges.

* Apply knowledge of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CDR, Section 1033) to design and build compliant, interoperable API interfaces on the Apigee platform.

* Define and enforce API design standards and governance guidelines, governing APIGEE Products and Proxies ,including naming conventions, versioning strategies, error response schemas, and pagination patterns.

* Facilitate and lead API design reviews and architecture walkthroughs, providing well-reasoned recommendations that guide engineering implementation decisions.

* Produce technical diagrams — sequence diagrams, flow diagrams, and system context maps — to document API behavior, data flows, Apigee policy execution, and integration touchpoints.

  
  

Leadership & Collaboration

* Communicate technical progress and risks proactively across engineering and product teams, managing competing priorities and keeping stakeholders aligned.

* Review delivery and API quality metrics regularly, identifying opportunities to improve development workflows, proxy performance, and governance processes.

* Mentor and upskill junior engineers through code reviews, proxy design walkthroughs, and structured knowledge-sharing sessions.

* Evaluate technical and business risk in design and implementation decisions, escalating issues with transparency to protect Citi and its clients.

  
  

Required Qualifications & Skills

* 8–10 years of experience in a product development, engineering, or technology product management environment, including 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and configuring APIs on Google Apigee (proxies, flow configurations, policy chaining, shared flows, and target endpoints).

* Advanced expertise in RESTful API design & architecture, OpenAPI 3.x specification authoring, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Deep knowledge of API security & identity standards, including OAuth 2.0 (OAuthV2 policies, Client Credentials), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles across API contracts and Apigee configurations.

* Strong understanding of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CFPB Section 1033) and global data privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) to ensure compliant, interoperable interface design.

* Skilled in vendor and partner management, effectively collaborating with third-party service providers to evaluate tools and drive solution delivery.

* Hands-on delivery in Agile environments, applying Scrum/Kanban practices to lead cross-functional sprint teams from concept through deployment.

* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with a data-driven, results-oriented approach to resolving complex system challenges and optimizing delivery metrics.

* Working familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Devin.AI) and prompt engineering methodologies to improve design velocity and documentation quality.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven capability to influence both senior technical and business stakeholders, articulate technical trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design walkthroughs.

Education

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
**FinOps Engineer**

**Company:** Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Product:** Fonazo – AI-Powered Voice Agent & Subscription Platform  
**Job Title:** FinOps Engineer  
**Experience:** 4+ Years  
**Qualification:** Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field  
**Location:** Pune  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Joining:** Immediate joiners preferred  
**Salary:** As per experience and industry standards

**Job Summary**

Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **FinOps Engineer with a strong background in Finance, FinTech, subscription billing, and payment gateway management** to manage the financial operations of our clients using **Fonazo, our AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform**.

The ideal candidate will have at least 4 years of hands-on experience managing subscription-based revenue models, recurring billing, payment processing, financial reconciliation, transaction settlements, refunds, chargebacks, and payment gateway integrations. The candidate should be familiar with payment service providers such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, 2Checkout (Verifone), Square, Payoneer, Amazon Pay, and similar platforms.

The role involves overseeing end-to-end financial operations for multiple clients, ensuring accurate subscription revenue tracking, monitoring payment performance, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining financial transparency across the Fonazo platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Subscription Billing & Revenue Management**

* Manage end-to-end subscription billing operations for Fonazo clients, including recurring payments, subscription plans, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and plan changes.
* Monitor subscription revenue, billing cycles, failed payments, pending invoices, and outstanding receivables to ensure accurate and timely revenue collection.
* Establish and maintain processes for tracking Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), customer lifetime value (CLV), churn, and subscription growth.
* Ensure accurate calculation of subscription charges, prorated billing, discounts, promotional offers, taxes, and other applicable fees.
* Identify billing discrepancies and revenue leakage, investigate root causes, and implement corrective measures.
* Coordinate with the product and development teams to improve billing workflows and automate subscription-related financial processes.

**2. Payment Gateway Management & Integration**

* Manage financial operations across payment gateways and subscription payment platforms, including Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay (FIS Global), 2Checkout (Verifone), Square, Payoneer, Amazon Pay, and other relevant providers.
* Configure and monitor payment gateway settings, transaction workflows, settlement schedules, payment methods, and recurring billing arrangements.
* Track payment success rates, declined transactions, gateway fees, transaction costs, refunds, and settlement discrepancies across providers.
* Coordinate with technical teams to troubleshoot payment gateway integration issues, API-related billing errors, webhook failures, and transaction status mismatches.
* Evaluate payment gateway performance, pricing structures, supported currencies, geographical coverage, and settlement timelines to recommend suitable solutions for clients.
* Ensure proper reconciliation between gateway transaction records, Fonazo subscription records, invoices, and bank settlements.

**3. Financial Reconciliation & Settlement Management**

* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of payment gateway transactions, subscription invoices, customer payments, refunds, and bank settlements.
* Verify gross transaction values, processing fees, commissions, taxes, net settlements, and pending or disputed transactions.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies between payment gateways, internal billing systems, accounting records, and bank statements.
* Monitor settlement delays, failed payouts, duplicate transactions, payment reversals, and unaccounted financial entries.
* Maintain accurate financial ledgers, transaction registers, settlement reports, and supporting documentation for audit and accounting purposes.
* Coordinate with the Accounts and Finance team to ensure proper recording of revenue, receivables, gateway charges, and settlement entries.

**4. Client Financial Operations & Account Management**

* Manage subscription-related financial operations for multiple Fonazo clients, ensuring accurate billing, payment collection, revenue reporting, and account-level financial records.
* Monitor each client's subscription plans, active subscriptions, transaction history, invoices, outstanding balances, refunds, and payment status.
* Prepare client-wise financial statements and reports covering subscription revenue, collections, failed payments, refunds, gateway charges, and net settlements.
* Coordinate with clients to resolve billing disputes, payment failures, invoice discrepancies, refund requests, and settlement-related queries.
* Maintain clear records of client transactions, payment histories, subscription changes, and financial adjustments.
* Ensure timely communication with clients regarding failed payments, pending dues, billing changes, and other subscription-related financial matters.

**5. Refunds, Chargebacks & Dispute Management**

* Manage refund requests, chargebacks, payment reversals, and disputed transactions in accordance with company policies and payment gateway requirements.
* Investigate transaction disputes, collect supporting evidence, and coordinate with payment service providers to facilitate timely resolution.
* Monitor chargeback ratios, refund trends, fraudulent transaction indicators, and recurring payment failures.
* Establish procedures for refund approvals, transaction verification, dispute escalation, and financial adjustment entries.
* Work with customer support and technical teams to identify the causes of payment disputes and prevent recurring issues.
* Maintain complete documentation of refunds, chargebacks, disputes, and their final outcomes.

**6. Financial Reporting, MIS & Analytics**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports covering subscription revenue, payment collections, transaction volumes, failed payments, refunds, and gateway settlements.
* Develop dashboards to track MRR, ARR, churn rate, renewal rates, payment success rates, outstanding receivables, and revenue leakage.
* Analyze payment gateway fees, subscription performance, client profitability, transaction costs, and revenue trends to support management decisions.
* Prepare client-wise and gateway-wise financial performance reports for internal management and business reviews.
* Identify financial irregularities, recurring billing issues, and operational inefficiencies through data analysis.
* Use Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar reporting tools to automate financial reports and improve data accuracy.

**7. Financial Controls, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Establish internal controls for subscription billing, refunds, payment settlements, revenue recognition, and financial adjustments.
* Ensure that financial operations follow applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, payment provider policies, and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Maintain appropriate transaction records, audit trails, approval workflows, and supporting documents for financial reviews and audits.
* Coordinate with internal finance, compliance, and technical teams to support applicable PCI DSS requirements and secure payment-handling practices.
* Monitor suspicious transactions, duplicate charges, unauthorized refunds, and potential payment fraud indicators.
* Support compliance with applicable data protection, customer billing, and payment-related requirements across relevant markets.

**8. Product & Technical Team Coordination**

* Work closely with product managers, backend developers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to improve Fonazo's subscription billing and payment management modules.
* Translate financial requirements into clear functional specifications for subscription plans, billing logic, invoices, payment retries, refunds, and settlement workflows.
* Validate payment gateway integrations, subscription lifecycle events, billing calculations, and transaction reconciliation during product releases.
* Coordinate testing of payment APIs, webhook events, recurring billing scenarios, failed payment recovery, and refund workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual reconciliation, improve financial accuracy, and streamline client onboarding.
* Contribute to the development of scalable financial workflows that support increasing subscription volumes and multiple client accounts.

**9. Subscription Performance & Payment Optimization**

* Analyze failed and declined transactions to identify the reasons for payment failures and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
* Implement and monitor dunning processes, automated payment retries, renewal reminders, and failed-payment recovery workflows.
* Evaluate payment gateway performance to improve transaction approval rates and reduce unnecessary processing costs.
* Monitor subscription cancellations, involuntary churn, payment-related customer drop-offs, and recurring billing issues.
* Recommend improvements to subscription pricing, billing frequency, payment methods, and collection workflows based on financial data.
* Work with product and customer success teams to improve renewal rates, customer payment experience, and subscription revenue retention.

**10. Accounting, Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Support subscription revenue forecasting, cash flow planning, payment collection projections, and financial budgeting for Fonazo operations.
* Maintain accurate records of accounts receivable, deferred revenue where applicable, payment gateway fees, refunds, and other subscription-related financial entries.
* Coordinate with the accounting team on monthly closing, revenue reconciliation, financial statements, and audit requirements.
* Analyze client-wise revenue, platform operating costs, payment processing charges, and contribution margins.
* Support the preparation of financial forecasts and management reports for business planning and operational decision-making.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen financial controls, reduce operating costs, and improve cash flow visibility.

**Required Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of subscription billing, recurring payments, payment processing, revenue reconciliation, and financial operations.
* Hands-on experience with one or more payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, 2Checkout, Square, Payoneer, or Amazon Pay.
* Knowledge of subscription lifecycle management, recurring billing, invoicing, payment retries, refunds, chargebacks, and settlement reconciliation.
* Understanding of financial reporting, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, payment gateway fees, and cash flow management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions, and financial reporting.
* Experience with financial dashboards, MIS reporting, and analytical tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Working knowledge of SQL and financial data analysis is preferred.
* Understanding of payment gateway APIs, webhooks, transaction statuses, and reconciliation workflows is an advantage.
* Familiarity with accounting or ERP systems and automated billing platforms is preferred.
* Knowledge of international payments, multi-currency transactions, cross-border settlements, and applicable tax treatment is an advantage.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline is required.
* A Master's degree in Finance, FinTech, Accounting, or Business Administration is preferred.
* Certifications in FinTech, payment systems, financial analysis, accounting, or relevant financial operations are an added advantage.

**5. Experience Requirements**

* Minimum **4+ years of relevant professional experience** in FinOps, subscription finance, payment operations, billing and reconciliation, or FinTech financial operations.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with payment gateways and recurring subscription payment systems.
* Experience managing financial operations for multiple clients, accounts, or subscription-based products.
* Proven ability to handle transaction reconciliation, failed payments, refunds, chargebacks, settlement reports, and revenue tracking.
* Experience working with SaaS platforms, AI products, voice-agent platforms, or other recurring-revenue business models is highly desirable.
* Experience collaborating with finance, product, engineering, and customer support teams to resolve complex financial and payment issues.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and timeliness of subscription billing and financial reconciliation.
* Reduction in unresolved settlement discrepancies and unaccounted transactions.
* Payment success rate and effectiveness of failed-payment recovery.
* Timeliness of client collections, refund processing, and dispute resolution.
* Accuracy and timely submission of financial MIS reports and dashboards.
* Reduction in payment gateway costs and preventable revenue leakage.
* Accuracy of client-wise subscription revenue and financial records.
* Effectiveness of billing automation and improvements in financial processes.
* Compliance with internal financial controls and audit requirements.
* Quality of coordination with clients, finance teams, and technical teams.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Job Summary:**  
Early-career Full Stack Engineer with a focus on AI Engineering to help build next-generation intelligent applications powered by large language models (LLMs). This role sits at the intersection of application development, data engineering, and applied AI—developing scalable systems that leverage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLM evaluation frameworks, and agent-based architectures.

You will work closely with platform, data, and product teams to build AI-powered experiences using Azure, Databricks, Postgres, and modern AI/agent frameworks.  
  
**Major Duties:**  
AI & Application Development

* Build end-to-end AI-powered applications (UI + backend services + model orchestration)
* Design and implement RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval and grounding
* Develop and deploy LLM-based workflows and agents (multi-step reasoning, tool use, orchestration)
* Integrate models via APIs and hosted platforms (Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, etc.)

LLM Evaluation & Quality

* Develop LLM evaluation frameworks (accuracy, hallucination detection, relevance, safety)
* Implement automated testing and benchmarking for prompt chains and agents
* Define and monitor LLM performance metrics (precision, recall, grounding fidelity)
* Support experimentation (prompt engineering, model comparisons, fine-tuning readiness)

Data & Backend Engineering

* Build and optimize data pipelines leveraging Databricks (Spark, Delta)
* Design and query structured and semi-structured datasets using Postgres
* Enable efficient retrieval layers (vector search, embeddings, indexing strategies)
* Support data modeling for AI use cases (knowledge bases, feature stores)

Platform & Agent Development

* Develop AI agents within Databricks and Azure ecosystems
* Integrate orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
* Build reusable services/APIs for agent capabilities (search, summarization, reasoning)

Full Stack Development

* Contribute to lightweight front-end interfaces for AI applications (React or similar)
* Build backend APIs/services (Python-based frameworks)
* Ensure production readiness (logging, monitoring, scalability, security)

**Experience & Qualification:**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in AI engineering, building AI applications, LLM, Python.
* B.E/B.Tech or above degree requried.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer** to develop, maintain, secure, test, and support enterprise integration solutions connecting complex business applications and services.

This role combines Java application development, systems integration, software security, automated deployment, application testing, and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience developing and supporting integrations using web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity within a secure enterprise environment.

The engineer is also expected to effectively use approved artificial intelligence-assisted development tools, including Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle to improve development efficiency, testing effectiveness, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall code quality. All AI-assisted output must be appropriately reviewed, validated, secured, and tested prior to implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and support secure, scalable Java-based enterprise integration solutions using REST and SOAP web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, interface, data-processing, and service-related issues while implementing enhancements to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
* Apply secure software-development practices and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security testing while maintaining system functionality and reliability.
* Manage application security requirements, including certificate, credential, and password rotations, and resolve related authentication and authorization issues.
* Maintain and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Support application releases, deployment validation, production issue resolution, and appropriate testing of application changes prior to implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, interfaces, deployment processes, and supported solutions.

* Accelerating code development, refactoring, integration development, and maintenance of existing solutions.
* Supporting development and refinement of unit and integration tests, code reviews, defect identification, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Assisting with analysis and remediation of application security findings.
* Supporting build and deployment automation, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Identifying opportunities to responsibly use AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 9+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise application using Java 8 or later and Spring Framework.
* Experience developing and supporting web services, application programming interfaces, and relational database integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues.
* Experience with source control, automated build and deployment pipelines, and modern software-development lifecycle practices.
* Knowledge of secure software-development practices, including application vulnerability identification, security testing, and remediation.
* Experience with application security concepts, including digital certificates, credentials, authentication, authorization, and password management.
* Experience developing and executing unit, integration, regression, and interface testing.
* Strong technical documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting complex, business-critical enterprise applications and integrations.
* Experience modernizing or migrating on-premises application and integrations to cloud-based environments.
* Experience with application security, certificate and credential management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience using Copilot or similar approved AI-assisted development tools to enhance software development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to independently investigate complex issues and drive them through resolution.
* Strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to effectively collaborate across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability for assigned solutions throughout the development and support lifecycle.
* Adaptability and willingness to adopt new technologies, tools, and development practices, including responsible use of AI-assisted capabilities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and engineering efficiency.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

**Senior AI Developer**

**About Principal: understand who we are**

With more than 19,000 employees worldwide, Principal helps people and companies in Asia, Australia, Europe, Latin America, and North America build and protect their financial well-being. We’ve been doing this for 143 years. A FORTUNE 500 company, we’re known for our innovative ideas and real-life solutions that help customers make financial progress, no matter their income or portfolio size. Principal (India) is the global business services (GBS) for Principal Financial Group with 4000+ employees.

For more information, visit www.principal.com Follow us on Xcorp (previously Twitter), Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

**Job Purpose: this section helps you understand the business and provides high level summary of the role**

The Senior AI Agent Developer will design, build, test, deploy, and improve production-grade AI agents and agentic workflows that solve defined business problems. This is a senior hands-on developer role, not a solution architect position. The role will translate business requirements and technical designs into secure, maintainable software using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, APIs, MCP servers, and agent orchestration frameworks. The developer will work closely with product, process, data, platform, security, and engineering teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Essential Deliverables: the section helps understand the job ownership and accountability**

· Design, build, and deploy AI agents, copilots, and agentic workflows leveraging enterprise AI platforms such as AWS AgentCore and MS Copilot Studio leveraging automation frameworks.

· Develop and orchestrate multi-agent solutions using modern orchestration frameworks, ensuring effective state management, routing, memory, tool selection, and human-in-the-loop controls.

· Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including knowledge ingestion, embeddings, vector search, retrieval optimization, and source attribution.

· Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, knowledge repositories, APIs, and cloud services to enable end-to-end business workflows.

· Build and manage MCP-enabled integrations to securely expose enterprise tools, data, and services to AI agents.

· Implement robust tool calling, function execution, validation, security controls, and audit logging to ensure reliable agent operations.

· Develop reusable AI components, prompts, connectors, and frameworks while maintaining high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation.

· Conduct functional, performance, security, and responsible AI testing, ensuring solutions are resilient against hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, and misuse.

· Establish monitoring and observability mechanisms to track agent performance, adoption, quality, cost, and business outcomes.

· Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions and drive successful deployment and adoption.

**Qualifications-Certifications-Relevant Work Experience:**

**Preferred educational background:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

**Total years of industry experience:** 8–10 years of experience in software engineering, automation, data, or AI application development, with significant hands-on development expertise. Proven experience delivering AI/GenAI solutions from prototype through production deployment. Strong background in integrating AI solutions within enterprise platforms and governed, security-conscious environments. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, architects, data engineers, security teams, and platform teams while maintaining ownership of solution delivery. Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts, evaluate trade-offs, document solutions, and drive user adoption

**Flexibility Option and Base Location**

**Principal offers modern hybrid working arrangements that allow all employees to adapt to changing work preferences.**

**Flexibility Option for the role:** Hybrid, 3 days in office

**Base Location**: Pune, India

Principal is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751373

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title:** AI Platform Engineering Manager

  

**Role Overview:**

EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team is looking for an **AI Platform Engineering Manager** to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively.

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own platform deployment** for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* **Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* **Architect for scale and resilience** — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* **Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers**, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems.
* **Manage model-hosting strategy**, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* **Build observability and monitoring** for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* **Drive security, compliance, and governance** of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* **Optimize infrastructure cost and performance**, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* **Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap**, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

  

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5–8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments.
* Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling
* Understanding of model-hosting economics, GPU resource management, and inference optimization techniques (quantization, batching, caching).
* Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

  

**Soft Skills / Leadership**

* Proven ability to lead engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working with Data SMEs, Product, Responsible AI, and business stakeholders.
* Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership.
* Comfortable operating in a "zero to one" environment — building platform foundations rather than maintaining existing ones.

  

**What We Offer:**

* A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact.
* Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement.
* A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth.
* Comprehensive support and guidance to develop into a transformative leader, equipped to navigate and excel in today's rapidly evolving technological landscape.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* **Governance:** embed ownership, lineage, metadata, data-quality standards, permissible-use expectations, and regulatory requirements into product design and delivery.
* **Accessibility through Data Mesh:** make governed enterprise data easier to register, certify, discover, access, and reuse across reporting, analytics, business applications, and AI-enabled solutions.
* **Commercial value through Data Products:** identify reusable data-product opportunities, validate demand, define target consumers, connect products to measurable use cases, and track adoption and realized benefits.
* **Consumption experience:** shape capabilities such as APIs, events, self-service onboarding, reusable integration patterns, reference implementations, and implementation guidance that make authoritative data easier for platforms to consume.
* **Product measures:** define and track measures at the platform and application level, including master-data consumption, adoption progress, data-product usage, implementation milestones, service performance, and business outcomes.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Operations, Governance, Risk, Finance, and business teams to align investment, sequencing, delivery capacity, controls, and adoption commitments.
* **Full product lifecycle:** lead from discovery and prioritization through delivery, release, adoption, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
* **Executive communication:** communicate strategy, progress, value, risks, dependencies, and decisions through concise, data-driven materials for senior business and technology stakeholders.
* **Trusted advisor and global partner:** act as a senior product leader who influences platforms and hubs that consume DSS capabilities without directly owning their engineering resources, and connects DSS product teams in Pune with stakeholders across regions and time zones.
* **Building the team:** over time, hire, coach, and lead Product Owners and Product Managers, and grow the DSS product capability in Pune, while continuing to own key products yourself.

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; Master's/MBA a plus.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of product management, data-product, platform-product, or related technology-delivery experience.
* **Enterprise delivery:** experience managing product roadmaps and end-to-end delivery in a complex enterprise environment.
* **Enterprise data depth:** strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, master/reference data, APIs, governance, and data quality.
* **Influence and execution:** demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional execution, including across geographies.
* **AI fluency:** credible understanding of how modern AI/GenAI depends on governed, high-quality data, and hands-on use of AI tools to accelerate product work.
* **Hands-on mindset:** recent, direct experience writing requirements, owning backlogs, and working day to day with engineers and data teams; comfortable being an individual contributor at a senior level.
* **Leadership readiness:** experience mentoring or leading product practitioners, or clear readiness to do so, with the judgment to balance personal delivery with developing others.

Preferred qualifications

* Financial services or other regulated-industry experience.
* Experience with client, product, or security master data and reference-data programs.
* Experience with Data Mesh, data-product operating models, data catalogs, or data contracts.
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations for data, such as BCBS 239, data privacy, and data residency.
* Experience moving from a senior individual-contributor role into people leadership, or building a product team from a small base.
* Experience working in or with a global capability centre in India.

title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  
  

Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.

  
  

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).

  

**We will count on you to:**

  

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
* You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
* You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
* Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
* Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation
  

**What you need to have:**

  

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.
* 12+ years of total experience
* Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
* You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
* A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
* Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
* Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent
  

**What makes you stand out:**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently
  

**Why join our team:**

  

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

  
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**The company built on breakthroughs.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Function/Dept Purpose Statement:**

The Manufacturing Excellence Team (MET) serves as the custodian of process equipment reliability, maintenance excellence and continuous improvement. The team drives and implements equipment and process improvements, executes cost-reduction and reliability enhancement projects, supports operations through advanced troubleshooting, and monitors equipment and process performance to improve efficiency, uptime and overall plant effectiveness.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Ensure safe working practices across all areas and implement & sustain PCPD requirements within process areas.
* Execute preventive, predictive, corrective and breakdown maintenance for electrical, controls systems and associated process equipment.
* Support teams in new equipment installation, technology transfer, safety improvements, process certification, cost reduction initiatives, documentation and training activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues and conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment and process failures.
* Troubleshoot and maintain electrical, instrumentation, and control systems, including PLCs, SCADA, HMI, servo drives, VFDs, sensors, actuators and associated field devices including set-up and programming
* Diagnose and resolve equipment breakdowns related to automation systems, machine controls, communication networks and motion control systems to minimize downtime.
* Read and interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, control schematics, and P&IDs.
* Maintain documentation related to statutory compliance, preventive maintenance, calibration, audits and other industrial standard requirements.
* Support the development and execution of plans to evaluate and implement improvements in existing technologies to enhance product quality, efficiency and reduce costs.
* Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor to understand equipment and process performance, identify improvement opportunities, and lead DMAIC-based problem-solving initiatives to resolve chronic issues and enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure electrical maintenance activities are carried out effectively to maximize equipment uptime, reliability and operational safety.
* Monitor equipment performance, analyze breakdown trends and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to improve plant efficiency.

**Required Experience:**

* 5–7 years of experience in process equipment automation & maintenance within a manufacturing environment.
* Good exposure to industrial safety practices and compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to deliver results while effectively managing multiple tasks, priorities and operational issues.
* Significant hands-on experience on the manufacturing floor, with a strong understanding of machines and production equipment, and a track record of resolving electrical and control-related challenges in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Practical experience in troubleshooting and problem-solving on production lines using reputed PLC and servo drive software, with the ability to understand PLC logic, make code changes and implement program updates effectively.

**Required Knowledge:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, E&TC, Instrumentation or Control Engineering.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong data analysis skills, including control charts, Pareto analysis and pivot tables, with a sound analytical mindset.
* Preference will be given to candidates with relevant experience in Manufacturing 4.0 practices, including communication protocols such as OPC UA, EtherNet, Profibus and serial communication, as well as data transfer between control systems and plant servers.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively both as a collaborative team member and as a team leader.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to develop proficiency in troubleshooting manufacturing equipment and analyzing manufacturing data.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Six Sigma Green Belt certification or experience in executing DMAIC projects will be preferred
* Familiar with AI

description:

The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.

This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.

The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.

**Principal** **Responsibilities/Requirements:**

  

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.
* Skill / ExperienceMinimum:· Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.· Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.· Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.· Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.· Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.· Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.· Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.· Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.· Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.· Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred. **Preferred**:· 3-5 years of relevant experience· Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
