Job Description

**Job Description – Lead Workato Developer (LMS Integration & Automation)**

**Experience:** 6–8 Years

**Role:** Technical Lead – Integration & Automation

**Platform:** Workato

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Lead Workato Developer with 6–8 years of hands-on experience in Workato and enterprise integration development to lead the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of integration workflows for Harbinger's Learning Management System (LMS) platform.

The role requires strong expertise in the Workato platform, including recipe development, API integrations, workflow orchestration, data transformation, error handling, and automation governance. The ideal candidate should combine deep technical expertise with the ability to lead integration initiatives, guide developers, and ensure the reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability of enterprise automation solutions.

The candidate will work closely with architects, business analysts, project managers, backend developers, and other technical stakeholders to translate business and integration requirements into robust automation solutions. They should also be forward-thinking in their approach to AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, and AI orchestration, identifying opportunities to improve delivery efficiency and evolve integration capabilities.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of Workato-based integrations and automation workflows for LMS platforms.
* Design, develop, and optimize complex Workato recipes using triggers, actions, conditional logic, data transformation, and reusable components.
* Build and manage integrations between LMS platforms and enterprise applications, databases, third-party systems, and custom APIs.
* Develop and maintain REST API integrations, webhooks, and event-driven workflows.
* Translate business requirements and technical specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable integration solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, review solution designs, and establish best practices for Workato development.
* Implement robust error handling, retry mechanisms, logging, monitoring, and exception management to ensure reliable workflow execution.
* Troubleshoot integration failures, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across interconnected systems.
* Guide developers in writing efficient recipes and following coding, documentation, and integration standards.
* Collaborate with backend engineers, architects, DevOps engineers, and QA teams to ensure seamless integration across the platform.
* Manage integration releases, environment configurations, testing, and deployment activities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, eliminate manual interventions, and improve automation performance.
* Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted development tools and Workato AI capabilities where appropriate to improve productivity and automation outcomes.
* Take ownership of integration architecture, technical quality, and long-term maintainability.

  

**Core Technical Skills**

* Workato Platform Expertise

* 6–8 years of relevant experience, including at least 6 years of hands-on Workato development experience.
* Strong expertise in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining complex Workato recipes.
* Experience with:
* Recipe development, triggers, actions, and conditional logic.
* Recipe functions, callable recipes, and reusable automation components.
* Data mapping, transformation, filtering, and orchestration.
* Error handling, retries, exception management, and operational monitoring.
* Workato connectors, including standard and custom connectors.
* API platforms, webhooks, and event-based integrations.
* Understanding of Workato environments, connection management, deployment practices, and access controls.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues and optimize recipe performance.

* API & Enterprise Integration

* Strong understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, JSON, and XML.
* Hands-on experience integrating SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, databases, and custom-built systems.
* Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms, including OAuth 2.0, API keys, and token-based authentication.
* Experience with pagination, rate limits, asynchronous processing, retries, and API error handling.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, system interoperability, and data synchronization.
* Exposure to microservices and event-driven architecture is preferred.

* LMS Integration Expertise

* Experience integrating Learning Management Systems (LMS) with enterprise applications and third-party platforms.
* Understanding of LMS workflows such as:
* User provisioning and learner account synchronization.
* Course and learning content synchronization.
* Enrollment, completion, and progress tracking.
* Learning records and reporting data exchange.
* Integration with HRMS, CRM, identity management, and other enterprise systems.
* Ability to understand LMS data structures and design reliable, automated data exchange workflows.
* Familiarity with standards such as SCORM, xAPI, or LTI is an advantage, depending on the integration requirements.

* Programming & Data Handling

* Strong understanding of data structures, data transformation, and validation.
* Ability to read, understand, and troubleshoot API payloads and integration logic.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Basic scripting knowledge in Python or JavaScript is preferred.
* Familiarity with regular expressions, data mapping, and JSON/XML processing.

* AI-Assisted Development & Automation

* Practical understanding of AI-assisted software development and automation practices.
* Ability to use AI tools to support workflow design, API analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, and test-case creation.
* Awareness of AI-driven workflow orchestration and intelligent automation capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Willingness to explore emerging Workato AI capabilities and identify relevant applications within LMS integration workflows.

  

**Technical Leadership & Governance-** The candidate should demonstrate the ability to:

  

* Own integration solution design and make sound technical decisions.
* Conduct design and code reviews to ensure adherence to established standards.
* Define reusable patterns and best practices for Workato development.
* Mentor developers and support technical problem-solving across the team.
* Establish standards for recipe naming, documentation, error handling, monitoring, and deployment.
* Identify integration risks, dependencies, and scalability concerns early.
* Ensure appropriate security controls, credential management, and access governance.
* Track integration reliability and recommend improvements based on recurring issues and operational metrics.
* Leadership & Collaboration Expectations
* Work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Project Managers, Backend Engineers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams.
* Lead technical discussions and contribute to integration planning and estimation.
* Break down complex integration requirements into manageable technical tasks.
* Support sprint planning, technical reviews, testing, and release readiness.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly.
* Take ownership of integration deliverables from requirement analysis through deployment and ongoing maintenance.
* Promote knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices.
* Engineering Mindset
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* A proactive approach to identifying integration challenges and preventing recurring failures.
* Focus on building scalable, reliable, reusable, and maintainable automation solutions.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with quality, security, and long-term sustainability.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and guide other developers.
* Curiosity and willingness to explore new Workato capabilities, integration patterns, and AI-driven automation opportunities.

  

Workato certifications, such as relevant Automation Pro credentials.

Experience with enterprise SaaS integrations, including LMS, HRMS, CRM, or identity management systems.

Familiarity with CI/CD practices and version control for integration development.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.

Understanding of data security, privacy, and enterprise integration governance.

Exposure to AI agents, LLM-based workflows, or AI orchestration platforms.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Workato technical leader with at least 6 years of Workato experience, capable of designing and managing complex enterprise integrations while guiding a development team. They understand that successful automation goes beyond connecting systems—it requires robust error handling, data integrity, security, scalability, and operational reliability.

They should be comfortable owning LMS integration workflows end-to-end, resolving complex technical challenges, establishing development standards, and identifying opportunities to leverage AI-assisted development and intelligent automation to improve delivery efficiency and platform capabilities.

title: AI Engineer - Sales and Marketing
description:
**Your role**
-------------

As a AI Engineer - Sales and Marketing, you are the hands-on builder who turns approved AI ideas into working solutions for Sales and Marketing – creating the AI agents, building the workflows and automations, and bringing in the right data so the tools are accurate, reliable and ready to use. You work under the AI Delivery Manager, who sets priorities and follows up, while you make the delivery actually happen. The role does not own the product roadmap or replace the Product Owner, and is governed through the councils, where the delivery need and business value are highest.

  

**You will:**

  

* Build and configure AI agents for Sales and Marketing – turning approved use cases into working Copilot agents, prompts and skills that are accurate, tested and ready for day-to-day use.
* Design and build the workflows, automations and integrations behind each solution – connecting systems such as CRM, quoting and pricing so tasks flow end to end without manual workarounds.
* Bring in and prepare the right data – identifying, connecting, cleaning and structuring the data sources each agent or workflow needs, and keeping that data current, governed and fit for purpose.
* Test, troubleshoot and refine delivered solutions – validating outputs, fixing issues and improving accuracy and reliability so each solution is stable and supportable before and after go-live.
* Work day to day under the AI Delivery Manager – taking on prioritised tasks, keeping work items clear and up to date, flagging blockers early and delivering to agreed timelines and quality.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders, AI Platform Teams and Microsoft to clarify requirements, confirm technical feasibility and ensure solutions fit existing platforms, security and governance standards.
* Document what has been built and support adoption – producing clear technical documentation, demos and worked examples, and providing hands-on support so solutions are understood, trusted and maintainable.

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

You have a Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent by experience.

* Hands-on experience building AI or automation solutions – for example Copilot agents, chatbots, RPA or low-code and pro-code automations; integrating systems and APIs; and working with data (extraction, transformation, modelling and quality); ideally delivered in an Agile, sprint-based way alongside product and business teams.
  

**Knowledge Areas/Skills:**

* Practical, build-level knowledge of Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse), Teams and SharePoint
* The ability to design and build workflows, automations and integrations
* Data engineering fundamentals covering connecting, cleaning, structuring and governing data
* A good understanding of Sales, Marketing, CRM, quoting, pricing and lead management processes so solutions fit real business needs
* A disciplined approach to testing and troubleshooting
* The ability to explain technical work in simple business language to non technical stakeholders
  

**Technical Skills**

Strong understanding of AI/ML architectures including LLMs, data handling, embeddings, and agent-based systems and experience with Azure AI ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, API Management, monitoring, identity & access control)  



**Other Requirements:**

* Hands-on, delivery-oriented and detail-focused, comfortable owning the build from idea to working solution, and able to work independently under the AI Delivery Manager while collaborating across multiple teams in a dynamic international environment.

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

* Culture of trust and accountability
* Lifelong learning and career growth
* Innovation powered by people
* Comprehensive compensation and benefits
* Health and well-being

**Job location**
----------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our office in Pune.

title: Senior Google SecOps Engineer
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Google SecOps Engineer to lead and deliver Google Security Operations (SecOps) implementation, migration, detection engineering, parser development, and SOAR automation initiatives. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR capabilities, successful execution of end-to-end migration projects, and expertise in YARA-L detection engineering. This role is critical for driving SIEM/SOAR modernization programs, enhancing security monitoring capabilities, and supporting enterprise Security Operations Centers (SOC).

  

* **Role: Senior Google SecOps Engineer**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead end-to-end migrations from legacy SIEM and SOAR platforms such as Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, ArcSight, LogRhythm, Exabeam, Cortex XSOAR, and Phantom to Google SecOps.
* Conduct discovery, assessment, planning, onboarding, implementation, testing, tuning, and migration validation activities.
* Design and implement scalable log ingestion architectures across cloud, network, endpoint, IAM, security, and application data sources.
* Develop custom parsers, parser extensions, UDM mappings, and telemetry normalization solutions.
* Design, develop, and optimize YARA-L detection rules to improve threat detection effectiveness.
* Convert detection content from SPL, KQL, AQL, Sigma, ArcSight rule formats, and other SIEM technologies into YARA-L.
* Build, migrate, and optimize SOAR playbooks, workflows, and security automation use cases.
* Integrate security tools and platforms using APIs for enrichment, triage, containment, remediation, and notifications.
* Support threat hunting, incident response investigations, forensic analysis, and SOC operations.
* Develop migration frameworks, onboarding standards, runbooks, validation plans, and operational documentation.
* Collaborate with security analysts, architects, engineers, and stakeholders to improve security monitoring capabilities.
* Perform detection tuning, alert optimization, and use-case enhancement activities.
* Assist organizations in strengthening threat detection, response, and security operations maturity.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-12 years of experience in Cybersecurity, SIEM Engineering, SOAR Engineering, SOC Operations, Incident Response, or Detection Engineering.
* Minimum 1+ year of hands-on experience with Google SecOps implementations and operations.
* Proven experience delivering at least one full-cycle Google SecOps migration project.
* Strong expertise in Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR capabilities.
* Hands-on experience with log onboarding, parser development, parser extensions, UDM mapping, and telemetry normalization.
* Strong experience developing YARA-L detection content from scratch.
* Expertise in converting detection rules from Splunk SPL, Microsoft KQL, Sigma, QRadar AQL, ArcSight, and other SIEM technologies.
* Experience designing and implementing SOAR automation workflows and security orchestration use cases.
* Strong understanding of threat detection, threat hunting, SOC operations, and incident response processes.
* Experience integrating EDR, IAM, Cloud Security, Vulnerability Management, Email Security, and Security Operations platforms.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs and third-party security tool integrations.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, security monitoring practices, and enterprise security architecture.
* Experience performing security use-case development, alert tuning, and operational optimization.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.

**Main responsibilities and tasks:**

  

* Lead Value Engineering studies on cast, machined and forged compressor parts and commodities, in close cooperation with Engineering, Product Management and Category Managers (Procurement).
* Develop and maintain detailed bottom-up should-cost models for castings, forgings and machined parts – covering raw material, process routing, cycle times, Machine Hour Rates (MHR), labour, energy, tooling, yield/scrap, overheads and profit structures – to define the cost baseline and identify use cases.
* Build and maintain MHR databases, commodity cost modules and cost libraries with documented assumptions.
* Benchmark supplier quotations against internal should-cost models and support fact-based cost negotiations.
* Validate manufacturing assumptions with Engineering.
* Assess manufacturing feasibility and drive Design-to-Cost / Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM) improvements across casting, machining and forging (e.g. material substitution, near-net-shape, process routing, tolerance and tooling optimisation).
* Train buyers and engineers on cost drivers.
* Establish close relationships and a safe environment with project stakeholders to discuss insights, align on targets and agree savings opportunities.
* Produce the documents required to present should-costing study results, including a final report with cost evaluation, recommendations and study finalisation.
* Provide clarifications and assistance to decision makers during the decision-making process.
* Prepare project charter, project closure, regular reports, KPI tracking and planning for the assigned projects.
* Report on progress and roadblocks to project stakeholders and the Value Engineering Global Manager.
* Attend follow-up sessions with Management when required.
* Support process implementation and interface definition across the Systems Division of Burckhardt Compression.
* Drive forward the Value Engineering and should-costing process with suppliers and 3rd parties.

  

**Education, Experience and Languages:**

  

* Graduation / Post-Graduation in Mechanical Engineering or similar.
* Atleast 8 years' experience in manufacturing engineering and/or value engineering, with in-depth hands-on knowledge of casting (sand/investment), machining and forging processes.
* Proven expertise in should-costing methodology and cost-estimation tools (e.g. Excel, CostData, aPriori, Facton, Teamcenter Product Cost Management or equivalent).
* Core technical competencies: cycle-time calculation, Machine Hour Rate (MHR) development, CAD drawing interpretation, GD&T and manufacturing tolerances, and data analytics.
* Solid knowledge of Value Analysis / Value Engineering methodology and international standards (e.g. API, ASME, ASTM); able to read technical drawings, GD&T and material specifications for cast, machined and forged parts.
* Basic know-how of Master Data and SAP transactions.
* MS Office and Power BI.
* AI tools and AI Agent creation
* Ability to travel up to 20% of work schedule.
* Language: local language and fluent English; basic technical vocabulary in both languages.

  

Burckhardt Compression creates leading compression solutions for a sustainable energy future and the long-term success of its customers. The Group is the only global manufacturer that covers a full range of reciprocating compressor technologies and services. Since 1844, its passionate, customer-oriented and solution-driven workforce has set the benchmark in the gas compression industry.

Data Engineering team under Center of Excellence (Data Science)

* Agent memory, state management, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Document intelligence and multimodal processing.
* Reusable agent tools, skills, manifests, and registration standards.

**Model Hosting and Inference**

Experience with one or more of the following:

* Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or Vertex AI.
* Hugging Face, vLLM, Ollama, Qwen, or other approved open-source model technologies.

**Platform Engineering, Security, and DevOps**

title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
description:
Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Location: Pune, India

  
  

**About GF**
------------

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

  

**Introduction**
----------------

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.

  
  

**Your Job**
------------

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
* Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
* Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
* Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
* Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
* Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
* Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.
  

  

**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
* Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **4 to** **8 years** of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
* Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
* Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
* Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262.
* Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms.
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments.
* Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.
* Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering.
* Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams.
  

  

**GlobalFoundries Equal Opportunity Statement**
-----------------------------------------------

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

### **No Recruitment Fee Policy**

GlobalFoundries is committed to ethical and transparent hiring practices. Candidates will not be charged any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. Any request for payment related to a GlobalFoundries employment opportunity is unauthorized and should be reported immediately. All legitimate recruitment communications are conducted exclusively through official GlobalFoundries channels. To report concerns or suspected recruitment fraud, please contact the Ethics & Compliance Office at global.compliance@globalfoundries.com. The Ethics & Compliance mailbox is not a recruitment channel. CVs/resumes submitted to this mailbox will not be reviewed, processed, or considered for employment opportunities. Please apply through the official GlobalFoundries careers site only.

* MITRE ATLAS

title: Domain Lead – QSR Operations & Food Cost (AI Restaurant Platform)

**Job title:** Domain Lead – QSR Operations & Food Cost (AI Restaurant Platform)

**Company:** Yutrix Labs LLP  
**Location:** Pune (Baner), hybrid. Occasional international travel to North America (2–4 weeks at a time).  
**Experience:** 8–12 years  
**Employment type:** Full-time

**About Yutrix Labs**  
Yutrix Labs is a Pune-based technology company building AI-native platforms for regulated and operations-heavy businesses. We are building an AI Restaurant Manager for a North American QSR franchise brand. It is an operating-control platform that watches inventory, food cost, food safety, service speed and loss prevention across restaurants. It flags exceptions with evidence and tells managers what to fix today.

We are looking for a domain lead who has run the back office of a QSR chain and wants to turn that experience into a product.

**What you will do**

* Own the business side of the product: inventory, purchasing and receiving, recipe and food cost, waste, cash control, HACCP/food safety, speed of service.
* Lead discovery workshops with the client’s operations, finance, procurement and QA teams, and with store managers.
* Turn SOPs and operating standards into system rules: thresholds, tolerances, severity levels, escalation paths and KPIs.
* Write user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and UAT scripts for the engineering and AI teams.
* Define how theoretical vs actual food cost, inventory variance, receiving variance and cash exceptions are calculated and explained.
* Review POS, inventory and purchasing data to assess data quality and design dashboards and reports.
* Support the pilot restaurant go-live: training, threshold tuning, and feedback from store teams.
* Act as the trusted operations voice with the client, and challenge scope where it doesn’t match how restaurants really work.

**What we are looking for**

* 8–12 years in QSR or fast-casual chains, with at least 3–5 years in restaurant operations, cost control, supply chain or operations excellence at a multi-unit or franchise brand.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of:
* Recipe/BOM costing, yields, portion standards and packaging BOMs
* Theoretical vs actual (AvT) food cost and variance analysis
* Inventory management: cycle counts, UOM conversions, FEFO/expiry, transfers, shrinkage
* Purchasing and receiving: par levels, reorder logic, 3-way match, price variance, supplier claims
* Store operations: opening and closing, waste capture, cash reconciliation, voids, refunds and discounts
* HACCP and food safety: temperature logs, holding times, cleaning, allergen control, audits
* Speed of service and KDS flow
* Franchise standards, audits and scorecards
* Experience working with technology teams on a POS, inventory, ERP or restaurant software rollout, as business owner or functional consultant.
* Strong analytical skills (advanced Excel; SQL is a plus).
* Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence running workshops with senior client stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Experience with restaurant systems such as POS/KDS, inventory and costing tools (e.g. Restroworks/Posist, MarketMan, Restaurant365, CrunchTime) or ERP purchasing modules.
* Central kitchen or commissary operations, halal or spec-compliant sourcing.
* Loss prevention or internal audit experience in F&B or retail.
* Exposure to North American or Middle East QSR markets. French is a bonus.

**Why join us**

* Shape an AI product from day one, alongside architects, data scientists and engineers.
* Work directly with an international QSR brand, with travel to the client.
* A small, senior team that builds fast and makes heavy use of AI tools.
* Competitive compensation.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,050,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Qlik Sense Developer with strong hands-on expertise in developing interactive dashboards, reports, and enterprise Business Intelligence solutions. * Integrate data from multiple sources, including relational databases, flat files, and enterprise applications.

* Define and implement KPIs, metrics, dimensions, and business calculations.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure reporting accuracy.
* Optimize Qlik Sense applications for performance, scalability, and usability.
* Troubleshoot dashboard, data-load, and performance issues and perform root cause analysis.

* Maintain technical documentation, data mappings, and report specifications.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives.

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in Qlik Sense dashboard and report development.
* 3+ years of experience with SQL, data analysis, and relational databases.
* 2+ years of experience with Qlik data modeling, load scripting, and ETL/data integration.
* 2+ years of experience developing enterprise BI solutions, KPIs, and data visualizations.

* BI Visualization: Qlik Sense
* Development: Qlik Load Script, Set Analysis, Expressions
* Data: SQL, Data Analysis, Data Validation

title: Team Leader – Quality Methods & Insights (QMI), Pune
description:
Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes - all while providing platinum customer support to our clients.

  
  
  
  

**The team:**

  

Data Management & Operations (DMO) serves as the Chief Operations Office for Bloomberg Data, with the Quality Methods & Insights (QMI) team acting as its strategic analytics and methodology partner. QMI drives data quality, timeliness, and operational efficiency across Bloomberg's data products by establishing quality governance standards, optimizing workflows, delivering common reporting and analytics, applying decision science to support investments and operational change, and developing workflow telemetry and productivity measurement capabilities. We partner closely with Data Operations, Vendor Management, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure global data processes scale efficiently, predictably, and with measurable quality outcomes.

  
  
  

**The role:**

  

In this role, you will lead a regional team of process engineers, data quality analysts, decision scientists, and analytics specialists who partner directly with APAC-based Data operations, Vendor Managers, and Product Engineering. You will act as the regional ambassador for QMI’s methodologies, driving high-impact initiatives that range from operational workflow measurement and vendor quality governance to process redesign. Success in this position requires a balance of inspirational people leadership, rigorous analytical craft, and executive stakeholder management. You will champion a culture of "context over control," empowering your team to solve complex problems independently while ensuring regional deliverables seamlessly align with QMI’s global strategic objectives across London, Princeton, and New York.

  
  
  

**We'll trust you to:**

* Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing APAC team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and technical excellence.
* Build strategic partnerships with regional Data, Operations, Product, Engineering, and Vendor Management leaders to identify priorities, align on outcomes, and drive data-driven decision making.
* Drive operational excellence through workflow measurement, process optimization, productivity benchmarking, and scalable automation initiatives, including AI-enabled solutions.
* Oversee data quality governance and decision analytics capabilities, leveraging statistical methods, experimentation, and AI evaluation frameworks to improve quality, quantify impact, and reduce operational risk.
* Partner with global QMI and Technical Project Management teams to deliver governed analytics platforms, reusable frameworks, and disciplined project execution, ensuring measurable business impact and consistent technical standards.

  
  

**You'll Need to Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of building, coaching, and developing high-performing analytical or technical teams.
* Strong analytical background in areas such as Applied Statistics, Decision Science, Data Quality, Operations Research, or a related discipline, with experience designing measurement frameworks and evaluating operational systems.
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with experience using tools such as Python, SQL, or equivalent analytics platform
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex cross-functional environments, and drive alignment across regional and global teams.
* Experience in operational performance and quality management, leveraging data-driven approaches to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making.
* Experience leveraging AI, causal inference, Bayesian modelling, and LLM evaluation to drive operational and decision-making improvements.
* Ability to scale impact through others by setting direction, coaching teams, and establishing repeatable frameworks and operating mechanisms.
* A strategic yet execution-oriented mindset, capable of balancing long-term capability building with immediate business impact.
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* Fluency in written and spoken English

  
  

**We’d love to see:**

* Familiarity with enterprise data quality and governance frameworks such as DCAM, DAMA, statistical quality monitoring, and semantic validation.
* Experience with modern data platforms and analytics architectures, including Spark, dbt, Iceberg/Delta, Lakehouses, or Knowledge Graphs.
* Knowledge of workflow management and operational tooling, such as Jira, queue management, or work routing platforms.
* Experience in financial market data, global operations, or third-party vendor management environments.

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime feel free to have a look at this: https://www.bloomberg.com/professional

  
  

**Learn more about our offices and benefits:**

India | https://www.bloomberg.com/India

  
  

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

title: Senior Java Technical Lead - Vice President

--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

This **Java Technical Lead** role is a senior-level software engineering leadership role embedded within Citi's Exchange-Traded Derivatives (ETD) Clearing technology organization, responsible for driving platform modernization and delivering strategic, business-critical capabilities across a global clearing infrastructure. The position sits at the intersection of hands-on Java development, cloud-native architecture, and engineering leadership supporting real-time message flows from global futures markets while leading the replacement of legacy product processors. The ideal candidate will bring deep enterprise engineering expertise, a track record of leading distributed teams, and a demonstrated commitment to AI-assisted software development practices. This role offers a compelling opportunity to shape the future of a mission-critical capital markets platform at one of the world's leading global financial institutions.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Deliver strategic initiatives within the ETD Clearing portfolio using Agile methodologies, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.
* Lead the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native applications, APIs, and services aligned with Citi's architecture and engineering standards.
* Perform hands-on Java-based development and provide L3 production support for the core ETD Clearing platform, including real-time message flows from global futures markets.
* Drive platform transformation efforts, including the replacement of legacy product processors and the adoption of modern cloud, containerization, and distributed systems technologies.
* Champion the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering tools to accelerate development cycles, automate processes, and improve troubleshooting efficiency.
* Establish and maintain CI/CD, DevOps, and observability practices to enhance platform stability, reliability, and time-to-market.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across global regions including Pune, India and with ETD technology leads to coordinate release planning and delivery.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, promote technical best practices, and cultivate a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration across engineering, QA, product, and business teams to deliver high-quality, reusable enterprise capabilities.
* Manage technical risk, application health, and regulatory compliance in alignment with Citi's standards for client and asset protection.
* Drive engineering excellence through automation, testability, reusability, and operational rigor across the full software development lifecycle.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* 10-15 years of hands-on software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale applications in complex, global environments.
* Deep expertise in Java-based application development, including Spring Boot, microservices architecture, and distributed systems design.
* Hands-on experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Solace in high-throughput, low-latency environments.
* Proven experience designing, building, and operating cloud-native applications on container platforms such as OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Docker.
* Strong understanding of API design, application security, and authentication and authorization frameworks, with a commitment to secure software development practices.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability tooling, and performance monitoring using technologies such as Git, Maven/Gradle, OpenTelemetry, and Grafana.
* Experience with caching and performance optimization technologies such as Redis or Couchbase.

title: Senior Engineering Manager- NKP
description:
**About the Team**

The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi-cloud environment.

NKP offers Container Attached Storage using Kubernetes pods to run AOS distributed storage fabric (Cloud Native AOS), enabling seamless integration with cloud native stateful workloads. The platform offers scale out, resilient and tiered storage. Supports storage features such as dynamic provisioning, thin provisioning, data efficiency, and application-centric snapshots. Cloud Native AOS can be used in both hyperconverged and disaggregated storage environments in a hybrid cloud environment. The stateful application Pods use the Nutanix CSI driver to consume storage entities that the AOS Pods present as Persistent Volumes. Much Like an on-premise HCI setup, Cloud Native AOS too provides all core Nutanix data management and copy data management functionalities.

**The Role**  
We are seeking a **Senior Engineering Manager** who is a “builder” at heart—someone who can architect complex storage software and, more importantly, architect the careers of the engineers who write it.

In this role, you will lead a team of talented junior and mid-level engineers. You will serve as the technical anchor and mentor, guiding the team through the challenges of containerizing our services while ensuring our storage control path remains the gold standard for performance and reliability.

You will design secure-by-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.

**Key Responsibilities**.

* Cloud-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads
* Architect, design and develop storage software for a computing+storage platform, Storage for AI - for cloud native environment.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Improve data path performance, scale-out and resiliency of our distributed control plane.
* Work closely with other development teams, testers, documentation writers and product management to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.
* Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Experience**: 12-18 years of software engineering experience and 2+ years of team management, with a proven track record of building large-scale distributed systems, cloud native platforms, or cloud infrastructure.
* **Storage Fundamentals**: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability. Understanding of the storage access protocols and features viz. SCSI/iSCSI/NFS/CIFS/S3/Cloud. Familiarity with x86 architecture, virtualization and/or storage management.
* **Kubernetes Expertise**: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Container Storage Interface (CSI), CNI, SCCs, MCS preferred
* **Systems Engineering:** Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), file systems, database back-ends, distributed storage systems and cloud based storage technologies. Experience with Hadoop, MapReduce, Cassandra, Zookeeper and other large-scale distributed systems preferred

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

**Work Arrangement**  
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. This role is based out of **Pune,** where employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of **3 days per week** to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager

title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**


**Location\- Pune**


### **What you will do**



As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands\-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.



Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.



The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.


**How you will do it:**


* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud\-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo\-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown\-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo\-blocking and reduction of the internet\-facing attack surface.


**What we look for:**


**Required**


* Deep, hands\-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on\-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security\-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
* Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
* Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi\-phase / multi\-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
* Strong vendor management experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
* Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
* Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
* 8\&\#43; years of proven, hands\-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.
* Network security Professional level certification preferred (e.g. Zscaler ZDTA/ZCCP/ZCCA, Fortinet NSE, Imperva, etc.); Zscaler certification strongly preferred.
* CISSP, CEH, CISM or CISA certifications is a plus.

### **About Us**


Since our establishment in 2005, we have been focused on helping our clients build their Software Products/Projects.  

  

  

Our founders had software development engineering background, our focus has always been in having strong delivery capability. This has resulted in extremely happy clients from day one and we continue to be the preferred partner for the clients we have acquired in our first year.  

As we continued our journey and growth, we have expanded our team with different technology stacks and right technical solutions. Our 200\+ people team continues to pleasantly surprise our clients across different technologies.  

### **Job Description**


**The role**
------------

  

You will build GenAI\-powered features that ship to real users: retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) services, structured data extraction from documents, LLM\-backed APIs, and agent\-style workflows with human review. You will also write the ordinary engineering that surrounds a model — validation, APIs, data access, tests and monitoring — because that is what makes an AI feature dependable. You will work in a team with a Technical Lead who reviews your designs and code.

  

This is a hands\-on engineering role, not a research or prompt\-writing role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build RAG pipelines end to end: document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector search, re\-ranking, grounded answers with citations.
* Implement structured extraction from documents and semi\-structured text into validated JSON, with confidence handling and fallback.
* Design and consume REST APIs around LLM features; integrate with existing applications and workflow pipelines.
* Implement tool calling and Agentic workflows with clear guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop steps where needed.
* Write evaluation sets and tests for LLM features — measure retrieval quality and answer accuracy, and catch regressions before release.
* Track cost, latency and failures in production; debug why a request went wrong.
* Follow good engineering practice: version control, code review, secrets kept out of code, readable and tested code.
* Use AI coding assistants productively while remaining accountable for what you commit.

**What you must bring**
-----------------------

* 1–2 years of hands\-on experience building LLM or GenAI applications, with at least one feature that real users have used — not only a notebook or a hackathon demo.
* Strong Python fundamentals; comfortable with FastAPI, Flask or Django for building APIs.
* Experience with at least one LLM API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or open\-weight models) and at least one vector store (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search, MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, FAISS).
* Working understanding of RAG concepts and failure modes: chunking trade\-offs, retrieval misses, hallucination, prompt injection, context limits.
* Structured outputs: function or tool calling, JSON schema, Pydantic validation.
* Git, basic Docker, and the habit of writing tests.
* Ability to explain, with reasons, when a rule or a simple lookup is a better choice than an LLM.

**Good to have**
----------------

* LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel or a similar framework — and the judgment to use them sparingly.
* OCR and document AI tools (Azure Document Intelligence, Tesseract, PaddleOCR).
* Evaluation tooling (Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo) or a harness you built yourself.
* Cloud experience, Azure preferred; workflow orchestrators (Temporal, Airflow, Prefect).
* Exposure to enterprise or regulated\-industry projects; any of AI\-102, AZ\-204 or equivalent certifications.

### **About Us**


Since our establishment in 2005, we have been focused on helping our clients build their Software Products/Projects.  

  

  

Our founders had software development engineering background, our focus has always been in having strong delivery capability. This has resulted in extremely happy clients from day one and we continue to be the preferred partner for the clients we have acquired in our first year.  

As we continued our journey and growth, we have expanded our team with different technology stacks and right technical solutions. Our 200\+ people team continues to pleasantly surprise our clients across different technologies.  

### **Job Description**


**The role**
------------

  

We need senior hands now. The AI practice runs several concurrent client platforms in regulated industries, and the engineering team supporting them is early\-career. The Technical Lead becomes the day\-to\-day technical owner of that team: the person who turns architecture decisions into implementable designs, runs the design gate, reviews the code, unblocks the hard problems personally, and tells the Chief Architect and delivery leadership the truth about risk.

  

Expect the split to be roughly half hands\-on engineering and half oversight. The hands\-on half is the difficult half: retrieval architecture, agent orchestration, extraction accuracy, performance and cost. The oversight half is where you multiply — three to five engineers with one to two years of experience become independent owners of their workstreams within six months because of how you review, mentor and set standards.

**What will you do**
--------------------

* Own technical delivery of AI workstreams across concurrent client engagements: scope, design, sequencing, quality and honest estimates.
* Run the pre\-implementation design gate: review engineers' design notes, apply the tiered checklist, maintain the decisions register, and approve or send back before code is written.
* Set and enforce engineering standards for LLM systems — evaluation suites as release gates, prompt and model versioning, cost and latency budgets, guardrails and injection defenses, human approval gates, evidence and audit trails.
* Personally build the hardest components: retrieval and re\-ranking architecture, tool\-calling and agent orchestration on Temporal, document extraction pipelines, on\-premises and offline deployments.
* Review code at scale, including code produced with AI coding tools; catch invalidated model output, leaked secrets, missing tests and silent behavioral change before they merge.
* Mentor early\-career engineers with a deliberate plan: pair on design, grade their design notes, expand their ownership as they earn it.
* Represent engineering with clients: explain trade\-offs in plain language, push back on unsafe or unbounded asks, and turn vague requirements into a bounded phase\-one scope.
* Hold the security posture: secrets management via Vault and Key Vault, data residency, least\-privilege access, and client confidentiality on on\-premises work.
* Build reusable Centre of Excellence assets — evaluation harness, RAG reference implementation, guardrail library, extraction patterns — so that the method travels across clients even when the code cannot.
* Assess codebases and delivery risk candidly and communicate upward early, including when the news is unwelcome.

**What you must bring**
-----------------------

* Two or more LLM systems that you shipped to production and operated, each with measurable quality gates. You can describe the incidents, what you measured, what you changed, and what you would do differently.
* Deep Python and strong system design: multi\-tenant SaaS, asynchronous pipelines, event\- or workflow\-driven orchestration, data modelling on document and relational stores.
* Evaluation rigor as a habit: you have built eval datasets, chosen the metrics, and used them to block a release.
* Cloud depth on Azure preferred (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AKS or App Service, Key Vault); AWS or GCP equivalents acceptable if the principles transfer.
* Led a team of three or more engineers through delivery, including design reviews and code reviews you were accountable for.
* Judgment about where a model does not belong, and the standing to say so to a client who wants one everywhere.
* Clear written communication: design documents, decision records, risk memos. Comfortable in client\-facing technical conversations.

**What would set you apart**
----------------------------

* Temporal in production; durable, idempotent, resumable workflow design.
* Document AI at depth: tiered OCR strategies, layout analysis, extraction accuracy measurement on real\-world scanned records.
* Computer vision for inspection or verification use cases (DETR\-family detectors, DINOv2 backbones, ensembling and box\-fusion methods) and release gates expressed as per\-class recall.
* Compliance frameworks applied to software delivery: GxP and 21 CFR Part 11, SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS.
* Test automation strategy with AI\-assisted authoring (Playwright), and the governance of AI coding tools inside an engineering team.
* Experience running a small engineering practice or CoE: standards, reusable assets, training, hiring.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
===============


The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.


Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap

**Requirements and Preferred Experience**
=========================================

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**


The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**


This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**


We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**


Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.
